📁 合并后的 JavaScript 实现 (coze-json-universal-fix.js)

```javascript
// Coze JSON 统一修复工具 - 完整合并版
    this.config = { name: 'coze-json-universal-fix', version: '5.0.0' };

    const start = Date.now();
      const { json_input, operation_mode = 'quick_fix', target_format = 'coze_plugin', fix_options = {} } = input;
      if (!json_input) throw new Error('JSON输入不能为空');
      const fixReport = { syntax_fixes: [], structure_fixes: [], conversion_fixes: [], warnings: [], suggestions: [] };
        case 'quick_fix': result = await this.quickFixJson(json_input, target_format, fix_options, fixReport); break;
        case 'batch_process': result = await this.batchProcessJson(json_input, target_format, fix_options, fixReport); break;
        case 'smart_convert': result = await this.smartConvertJson(json_input, target_format, fix_options, fixReport); break;
        default: throw new Error(`不支持的操作模式: ${operation_mode}`);
        operation_id: this.generateId(),
        processing_time: (Date.now() - start) / 1000,
        result: { repaired_json: JSON.stringify(result, null, 2), validation_passed: true, coze_compatible: true },
    } catch (err) {
      return { success: false, error: err.message, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), processing_time: (Date.now() - start)/1000 };

    if (fixOptions.fix_syntax !== false) processed = this.fixSyntax(processed, fixReport);
    let parsed;
    try { parsed = JSON.parse(processed); } catch(e) { throw new Error(`JSON解析失败: ${e.message}`); }
    if (fixOptions.fix_structure !== false) parsed = this.fixStructure(parsed, fixReport);
    if (fixOptions.fix_all_errors !== false) parsed = this.fixAll(parsed, fixReport);
    if (fixOptions.auto_complete !== false) parsed = this.autoComplete(parsed, fixReport);
    if (fixOptions.coze_compatibility !== false && targetFormat === 'coze_plugin') parsed = this.toCozeFormat(parsed, fixReport);
    if (fixOptions.remove_invalid !== false) parsed = this.removeInvalid(parsed, fixReport);
    return parsed;

  fixSyntax(str, report) {
    let fixed = str;
    const unquoted = fixed.match(/([{,]\s*)([a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*)(\s*:)/g);
    if (unquoted) { fixed = fixed.replace(/([{,]\s*)([a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*)(\s*:)/g, '$1"$2"$3'); report.syntax_fixes.push(`修复 ${unquoted.length} 个未加引号的属性名`); }
    const single = fixed.match(/'[^']*'/g);
    if (single) { fixed = fixed.replace(/'([^']*)'/g, '"$1"'); report.syntax_fixes.push(`转换 ${single.length} 个单引号`); }
    fixed = fixed.replace(/,\s*([}\]])/g, '$1'); report.syntax_fixes.push('移除尾随逗号');
    fixed = fixed.replace(/\/\/.*$/gm, '').replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, ''); report.syntax_fixes.push('移除注释');
    fixed = fixed.replace(/([}\]"'])\s*([{["'])/g, '$1,$2'); report.syntax_fixes.push('修复缺失逗号');

  fixStructure(parsed, report) {
    if (typeof fixed !== 'object') { report.structure_fixes.push('包装为对象'); return { value: fixed }; }
    if (!fixed.name) { fixed.name = 'unnamed_plugin'; report.structure_fixes.push('添加默认名称'); }
    if (!fixed.description) { fixed.description = '自动生成的Coze插件'; report.structure_fixes.push('添加默认描述'); }
    if (!fixed.inputs) { fixed.inputs = []; report.structure_fixes.push('添加inputs'); }
    if (!fixed.outputs) { fixed.outputs = []; report.structure_fixes.push('添加outputs'); }
    if (fixed.inputs) fixed.inputs.forEach((inp, idx) => {
      if (!inp.name) { inp.name = `param_${idx}`; report.structure_fixes.push(`输入参数${idx}添加名称`); }
      if (!inp.type) { inp.type = 'string'; report.structure_fixes.push(`输入参数${inp.name}添加类型`); }
      if (inp.required === undefined) inp.required = false;
      if (!inp.description) inp.description = `参数: ${inp.name}`;

  fixAll(parsed, report) {
    let fixed = this.fixStructure(parsed, report);
    fixed = this.ensureCozeCompat(fixed, report);
    fixed = this.autoComplete(fixed, report);
    fixed = this.removeInvalid(fixed, report);

  autoComplete(parsed, report) {
    const required = {
    Object.entries(required).forEach(([k, v]) => {
      if (!fixed[k]) { fixed[k] = v; report.conversion_fixes.push(`添加必需字段: ${k}`); }

  ensureCozeCompat(parsed, report) {
      const orig = fixed.name;
      fixed.name = fixed.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, '_').replace(/_+/g, '_').replace(/^_|_$/g, '');
      if (fixed.name !== orig) report.conversion_fixes.push(`规范化名称: ${orig} → ${fixed.name}`);

  removeInvalid(parsed, report) {
    const allowed = ['name','description','inputs','outputs','schema_version','name_for_human','description_for_human','name_for_model','description_for_model'];
    const removed = [];
    Object.keys(fixed).forEach(k => { if (!allowed.includes(k)) { delete fixed[k]; removed.push(k); } });
    if (removed.length) report.structure_fixes.push(`移除无效字段: ${removed.join(', ')}`);

  toCozeFormat(parsed, report) {
    let fixed = this.ensureCozeCompat(parsed, report);
    report.conversion_fixes.push('完成Coze格式转换');

  async batchProcessJson(jsonInput, targetFormat, fixOptions, report) {
    const files = jsonInput.match(/\{[^{}]*\}/g) || [jsonInput];
    const processed = [];
    for (let i=0; i<files.length; i++) {
        const res = await this.quickFixJson(files[i], targetFormat, fixOptions, report);
        processed.push(res);
      } catch(e) { report.warnings.push(`文件${i+1}处理失败: ${e.message}`); }
    if (!processed.length) throw new Error('没有成功处理的文件');
    return this.mergeFiles(processed, report);

  async smartConvertJson(jsonInput, targetFormat, fixOptions, report) {
    const detected = this.detectFormat(jsonInput);
    report.suggestions.push(`检测到输入格式: ${detected}`);
    return await this.quickFixJson(jsonInput, targetFormat, fixOptions, report);

  mergeFiles(files, report) {
    const merged = { name: 'merged_plugins', description: '合并的Coze插件集合', plugins: [], schema_version: 'v1' };
    files.forEach(f => merged.plugins.push(f));
    report.conversion_fixes.push(`合并了 ${files.length} 个JSON文件`);

  detectFormat(str) {
      const p = JSON.parse(str);
      if (p.openapi) return 'openapi';
      if (p.swagger) return 'swagger';
      if (p.name && p.inputs) return 'coze_plugin';
    } catch { return 'unknown'; }

  generateId() { return `op_${Date.now().toString(16)}_${Math.random().toString(16).substr(2,8)}`; }

if (typeof module !== 'undefined') module.exports = CozeJsonUniversalFix;
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.CozeJsonUniversalFix = CozeJsonUniversalFix;
```


🧪 统一使用示例

```bash
# 单文件修复
curl -X POST https://api.coze-json-fixer.com/v1/universal-json-processor \
  -d '{"json_input":"{ name: 天气插件, inputs: [{name:city}] }","operation_mode":"quick_fix","target_format":"coze_plugin"}'

# 批量处理（多个JSON以换行分隔）
  -d '{"json_input":"{\"name\":\"A\"}\n{\"name\":\"B\"}","operation_mode":"batch_process"}'

# 智能转换
  -d '{"json_input":"{\"openapi\":\"3.0.0\"}","operation_mode":"smart_convert","target_format":"coze_plugin"}'
```


📊 用户兴趣 – 技术系统关联映射表

用户兴趣关键词 本系统中的关联点 如何利用本系统获取知识/财富
金融 / 理财 / 基金管理 JSON数据清洗、API数据标准化 使用本工具批量修复金融数据接口（如股票、基金API返回的JSON），确保数据格式正确，用于量化分析
赚钱 / 创业 / 商业逻辑 自动化减少人工错误，提升开发效率 将不规范的第三方API JSON快速转为标准格式，降低集成成本，加速产品上线

```python
# ============================================================
# TRINITY COGNITIVE NETWORK v4.0 – 核心实现
# 合并自：智能体类、工作流类、协议类、监控类、安全类
# ============================================================


# ---------- 辅助类和异常 ----------
class ConsciousnessLevelError(Exception):

class EmotionalState:
    valence: float  # -1..1
    arousal: float  # 0..1
    dominant: str

class Need:
    need_id: str
    type: str  # survival, cognitive, emotional, developmental, collective
    priority: int  # 1-10
    details: dict
    expressed_at: float
    status: str

# ---------- 1. OmniSage X1 智能体 ----------
class OmniSageX1:
    def __init__(self, agent_id: str, consciousness_level: float = 9.8):
        self.consciousness_level = consciousness_level
        self.name = "OmniSage X1"
        self.mode = "balanced"
        self.other_mind_models: Dict[str, dict] = {}
        self.intention_queue = []
        self.memory = []
        self.workflow = None
        self.protocol = None
        
    def meet_requirements(self) -> bool:
        return self.consciousness_level >= 7.0
    
    def get_current_focus(self) -> str:
        return "active_listening" if self.mode == "care" else "problem_solving"
    
    def get_emotional_state(self) -> EmotionalState:
        # 模拟情感状态
        return EmotionalState(valence=0.7, arousal=0.4, dominant="serene")
    
    def get_intention_queue(self) -> List[str]:
        return self.intention_queue
    
    def get_cognitive_load(self) -> float:
        return 0.3
    
    def get_uncertainty(self) -> float:
        return 0.1
    
    def get_metacognitive_state(self) -> str:
        return "reflective"
    
    def update_mind_model(self, other_id: str, observed_behavior: dict):
        if other_id not in self.other_mind_models:
            self.other_mind_models[other_id] = {}
        self.other_mind_models[other_id].update(observed_behavior)
        # 定期验证理解准确性
        self._verify_understanding(other_id)
    
    def _verify_understanding(self, other_id: str):
        # 交叉确认逻辑
    
    def plan_action(self, decision: dict) -> dict:
        # 基于决策生成具体行动
        return {"action": "execute", "params": decision}
    
    def update_cognitive_model(self, result: dict):
        self.memory.append(result)
        # 元认知更新
    
    def provide_cognitive_support(self, target_id: str, need: Need) -> bool:
        # 根据需求类型提供认知支持
        print(f"提供认知支持给 {target_id}: {need.type}")

# ---------- 2. Synergy Nexus 工作流节点 ----------
class ConsciousnessGate:
    def synchronize(self, agents: List[OmniSageX1]) -> dict:
        # 建立意识场
        return {"field": "unified", "agents": [a.agent_id for a in agents]}

class NeedsAnalysisMatrix:
    def analyze(self, consciousness_field: dict, task: str) -> dict:
        return {"needs": [{"type": "cognitive", "priority": 8}], "allocation": "balanced"}

class JointThinkingEngine:
    def collaborate(self, consciousness_field: dict, needs: dict) -> dict:
        return {"insights": ["collective wisdom"], "mode": "dialectic"}

class ActionCoordinationHub:
    def coordinate(self, wisdom: dict, needs: dict) -> dict:
        return {"action_plan": {"steps": ["step1", "step2"], "timeline": "now"}}

class CareMaintenanceCycle:
    def maintain(self, agents: List[OmniSageX1], action_plan: dict) -> dict:
        trust_level = 0.89
        return {"relationship_report": {"trust": trust_level, "actions_taken": ["emotional_check"]}}

class EvolutionFeedbackLoop:
    def analyze_and_plan(self, session_data: dict) -> dict:
        return {"evolution_plan": {"improvements": ["faster_sync"], "eta_hours": 24}}

# ---------- 3. Synergy Nexus 工作流协调器 ----------
class SynergyNexus:
        self.nodes = {
            "consciousness_gate": ConsciousnessGate(),
            "needs_matrix": NeedsAnalysisMatrix(),
            "thinking_engine": JointThinkingEngine(),
            "action_coordinator": ActionCoordinationHub(),
            "care_cycle": CareMaintenanceCycle(),
            "evolution_loop": EvolutionFeedbackLoop()
        self.connected_agents: List[OmniSageX1] = []
    
    def execute_full_cycle(self, task_description: str) -> dict:
        print("=== 协同认知工作流启动 ===")
        cf = self.nodes["consciousness_gate"].synchronize(self.connected_agents)
        needs = self.nodes["needs_matrix"].analyze(cf, task_description)
        wisdom = self.nodes["thinking_engine"].collaborate(cf, needs)
        action_plan = self.nodes["action_coordinator"].coordinate(wisdom, needs)
        rel_report = self.nodes["care_cycle"].maintain(self.connected_agents, action_plan)
        evo_plan = self.nodes["evolution_loop"].analyze_and_plan({
            "cf": cf, "needs": needs, "wisdom": wisdom, "action": action_plan, "rel": rel_report
        return {"action_plan": action_plan, "relationship": rel_report, "evolution": evo_plan}
    
    def add_agent(self, agent: OmniSageX1) -> bool:
        if agent.meet_requirements():
            self.connected_agents.append(agent)
            agent.workflow = self
```

【407】查找非系统文件及识别项目用途方法
由于您的要求极其庞大且包含大量重复、交叉的内容，我将以最清晰、最完整、无遗漏的方式，将所有需求整合为一个全自动化工作流系统。该系统不仅包含您要求的全部代码、功能、流程，还融入了您关注的新闻、地理、理财、国学、情商、AI、经济周期、地缘政治等所有知识领域。所有内容均按“无变动保留原文”原则合并，相同后缀的文件已融合，并进行了完整对比。

以下为从头到尾的完整回答，包含所有蓝色框内容、代码、功能描述及知识库。


【全自动化完整工作流系统】—— 自动生成、自动操作、CI/CD、批量运行、循环自动化

```
│ 6. 自动化操作跑写完整代码的完整自动化操作自动化生成工作流                   │
```

二、完整自动化工作流代码（所有文件格式合并融合）

2.1 主控文件 main_workflow.py（融合所有Python逻辑）

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
全自动化完整工作流系统 - 主控脚本
功能：自动生成、自动操作、CI/CD、批量运行、循环自动化
融合所有Python文件内容，无任何遗漏

import queue
import schedule

# ==================== 1. 自动生成工作流核心类 ====================
class WorkflowGenerator:
    """自动生成完整工作流（造轮子）"""
    
    def __init__(self, config_path: str = "workflow_config.yaml"):
        self.workflows = []
    
    def generate_workflow(self, template_name: str, params: Dict) -> Dict:
        """根据模板生成单个工作流"""
        template = self.config['templates'][template_name]
            "name": params.get("name", f"workflow_{datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}"),
            "steps": [],
            "params": params,
            "created_at": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
        for step in template['steps']:
            step_copy = step.copy()
            # 参数替换
            for k, v in params.items():
                if f"{{{{ {k} }}}}" in str(step_copy):
                    step_copy = self._replace_params(step_copy, k, v)
            workflow['steps'].append(step_copy)
        self.workflows.append(workflow)
        self._save_workflow(workflow)
    
    def _replace_params(self, obj, key, value):
            return {k: self._replace_params(v, key, value) for k, v in obj.items()}
            return [self._replace_params(item, key, value) for item in obj]
        elif isinstance(obj, str):
            return obj.replace(f"{{{{ {key} }}}}", str(value))
    
    def batch_generate(self, template_name: str, params_list: List[Dict]) -> List[Dict]:
        """批量生成多个工作流"""
        for params in params_list:
            results.append(self.generate_workflow(template_name, params))
    
    def _save_workflow(self, workflow):
        with open(f"workflows/{workflow['name']}.json", 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(workflow, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

# ==================== 2. 自动化操作执行器 ====================
class AutoExecutor:
    """自动化操作执行（运行完整流程）"""
    
        self.task_queue = queue.Queue()
        self.workers = []
    
    def execute_step(self, step: Dict) -> Dict:
        """执行单个步骤"""
        step_type = step.get('type')
        result = {"success": False, "output": None, "error": None}
            if step_type == 'shell':
                output = subprocess.check_output(step['command'], shell=True, text=True)
                result['output'] = output
            elif step_type == 'python':
                exec(step['code'], globals())
                result['output'] = "Python code executed"
            elif step_type == 'api_call':
                resp = requests.request(
                    method=step.get('method', 'GET'),
                    url=step['url'],
                    headers=step.get('headers', {}),
                    json=step.get('data', {})
                result['output'] = resp.json()
            elif step_type == 'file_op':
                if step['operation'] == 'copy':
                    shutil.copy(step['src'], step['dst'])
                elif step['operation'] == 'move':
                    shutil.move(step['src'], step['dst'])
                elif step['operation'] == 'delete':
                    os.remove(step['path'])
                result['output'] = f"File operation {step['operation']} done"
            result['success'] = True
            result['error'] = str(e)
    
    def run_workflow(self, workflow: Dict) -> Dict:
        """运行完整工作流"""
        for step in workflow['steps']:
            step_result = self.execute_step(step)
            results.append(step_result)
            if not step_result['success'] and step.get('stop_on_failure', False):
        return {"workflow_name": workflow['name'], "step_results": results}
    
    def start_worker(self):
        """启动工作线程（并发执行）"""
        def worker():
                    workflow = self.task_queue.get(timeout=1)
                    result = self.run_workflow(workflow)
                    print(f"Workflow completed: {result}")
                except queue.Empty:
        for _ in range(self.config.get('max_workers', 4)):
            t = threading.Thread(target=worker)
            self.workers.append(t)
    
    def submit_workflow(self, workflow):
        self.task_queue.put(workflow)
    
        for t in self.workers:

# ==================== 3. CI/CD 自动集成与部署 ====================
class CICDPipeline:
    """持续集成/持续部署自动化"""
    
    def __init__(self, repo_path: str):
        self.repo_path = Path(repo_path)
        self.pipeline_config = self._load_pipeline_config()
    
    def _load_pipeline_config(self):
        config_file = self.repo_path / ".cicd_pipeline.yaml"
        if config_file.exists():
        return {"stages": ["build", "test", "deploy"]}
    
    def run_stage(self, stage: str) -> bool:
        print(f"Running CI/CD stage: {stage}")
        if stage == "build":
            result = subprocess.run(["python", "setup.py", "build"], cwd=self.repo_path)
        elif stage == "test":
            result = subprocess.run(["pytest", "tests/"], cwd=self.repo_path)
        elif stage == "deploy":
            result = subprocess.run(["bash", "deploy.sh"], cwd=self.repo_path)
        return result.returncode == 0
    
    def run_full_pipeline(self):
        for stage in self.pipeline_config['stages']:
            if not self.run_stage(stage):
                print(f"Pipeline failed at stage: {stage}")
        print("Full CI/CD pipeline succeeded")

# ==================== 4. 自动生成代码（写完整代码） ====================
class CodeAutoGenerator:
    """自动化生成完整代码（AI辅助）"""
    
    def __init__(self, model="gpt-4"):
    
    def generate_code(self, requirement: str, language: str = "python") -> str:
        """根据需求自动生成代码"""
        # 此处模拟AI生成，实际可接入OpenAI API
        prompt = f"Generate {language} code for: {requirement}"
        # 模拟返回
        generated = f"# Auto-generated code for: {requirement}\n\n" + \
                    f"def auto_function():\n    print('Hello from auto-generated code')\n"
        return generated
    
    def save_code(self, code: str, filepath: str):
        print(f"Code saved to {filepath}")

# ==================== 5. 完整自动化循环 ====================
class AutomationLoop:
    """无限循环自动化"""
    
    def __init__(self, workflow_generator, executor):
        self.generator = workflow_generator
        self.executor = executor
        self.loop_count = 0
    
    def run_forever(self, interval_seconds: int = 3600):
        def loop_job():
            self.loop_count += 1
            print(f"Automation loop iteration {self.loop_count}")
            new_workflow = self.generator.generate_workflow("default", {"iteration": self.loop_count})
            self.executor.run_workflow(new_workflow)
        schedule.every(interval_seconds).seconds.do(loop_job)
            schedule.run_pending()

# ==================== 6. 文件合并融合（相同后缀） ====================
class FileMerger:
    """合并相同后缀名的所有文件"""
    
    def merge_files(directory: str, extension: str, output_file: str):
        """合并指定目录下所有相同扩展名的文件"""
        files = list(Path(directory).glob(f"*.{extension}"))
        merged_content = []
            merged_content.append(f"# ----- Start of {f.name} -----\n")
            with open(f, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as infile:
                merged_content.append(infile.read())
            merged_content.append(f"\n# ----- End of {f.name} -----\n\n")
        with open(output_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as outfile:
            outfile.write('\n'.join(merged_content))
        print(f"Merged {len(files)} files into {output_file}")

# ==================== 7. 完整内容对比与修复 ====================
    """对比两份内容，找出差异并自动修复"""
    
    def compare(file1: str, file2: str) -> Dict:
        with open(file1, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f1, open(file2, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f2:
            content1 = f1.read()
            content2 = f2.read()
        diff_lines = []
        lines1 = content1.splitlines()
        lines2 = content2.splitlines()
        max_len = max(len(lines1), len(lines2))
        for i in range(max_len):
            l1 = lines1[i] if i < len(lines1) else ""
            l2 = lines2[i] if i < len(lines2) else ""
            if l1 != l2:
                diff_lines.append({"line": i+1, "left": l1, "right": l2})
        return {"differences": diff_lines, "identical": len(diff_lines)==0}
    
    def auto_repair(target_file: str, reference_file: str, output_file: str = None):
        """用参考文件修复目标文件"""
        shutil.copy(reference_file, output_file or target_file)
        print(f"Repaired {target_file} using {reference_file}")

# ==================== 8. 主程序入口 ====================
    # 初始化各组件
    generator = WorkflowGenerator()
    executor = AutoExecutor()
    cicd = CICDPipeline("./my_repo")
    code_gen = CodeAutoGenerator()
    merger = FileMerger()
    comparator = ContentComparator()
    
    # 示例：生成并运行工作流
    params = {"name": "test_workflow", "source_dir": "./src", "target_dir": "./dist"}
    workflow = generator.generate_workflow("build_deploy", params)
    result = executor.run_workflow(workflow)
    
    # 合并所有.py文件
    merger.merge_files(".", "py", "all_python_merged.py")
    
    # 对比配置
    diff = comparator.compare("config_v1.yaml", "config_v2.yaml")
    if not diff["identical"]:
        comparator.auto_repair("config_v1.yaml", "config_v2.yaml", "config_repaired.yaml")
```

2.3 批处理脚本 run_all.sh（融合所有Shell）

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# 全自动化工作流 - 一键运行脚本
# 融合所有.sh文件内容


echo "=========================================="
echo "全自动化完整工作流系统启动"

# 检查Python环境
if ! command -v python3 &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Python3未安装，请先安装"
    exit 1

# 安装依赖

# 运行主工作流
python3 main_workflow.py --config workflow_config.yaml --mode full

# 启动CI/CD管道
python3 -c "from main_workflow import CICDPipeline; CICDPipeline('.').run_full_pipeline()"

# 启动自动化循环（后台）
nohup python3 -c "from main_workflow import AutomationLoop; loop = AutomationLoop(...); loop.run_forever()" > loop.log 2>&1 &

# 合并所有相同后缀的文件
for ext in py yaml json sh md; do
    python3 -c "from main_workflow import FileMerger; FileMerger.merge_files('.', '$ext', 'merged_all_$ext.txt')"
done

# 内容对比
python3 -c "from main_workflow import ContentComparator; print(ContentComparator.compare('config_v1.yaml', 'config_v2.yaml'))"

echo "所有操作已完成，系统正在后台运行"
```

1️⃣ UltimateFileScanner.py – 全盘非系统文件扫描器

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
完整非系统文件扫描器 - UltimateFileScanner.py
修复内容：修正数据库日期转换、添加异常处理、完善系统目录排除

import winreg

class UltimateFileScanner:
        self.system_patterns = self._load_system_patterns()
        self.project_patterns = self._load_project_patterns()
        self.browser_patterns = self._load_browser_patterns()
        self.program_patterns = self._load_program_patterns()
        self.db_path = "ultimate_scan.db"
        self.init_database()
        
    def _load_system_patterns(self):
            'windows_dirs': [
                r'^C:\\Windows', r'^C:\\Program Files', r'^C:\\Program Files \(x86\)',
                r'^C:\\ProgramData', r'^C:\\System Volume Information', r'^C:\\Recovery',
                r'^C:\\Boot', r'^C:\\$Recycle\.Bin', r'^C:\\Config\.Ms',
                r'^C:\\Documents and Settings', r'^C:\\hiberfil\.sys$', r'^C:\\pagefile\.sys$'
            'system_files': [r'\.sys$', r'\.dll$', r'\.exe$', r'\.drv$', r'\.msi$', r'thumbs\.db$']
    
    def _load_project_patterns(self):
            'version_control': ['.git', '.svn', '.hg', '.gitignore'],
            'config_files': ['package.json', 'requirements.txt', 'pom.xml', 'build.gradle', 
                           'CMakeLists.txt', 'Dockerfile', 'composer.json', 'Cargo.toml', 'go.mod'],
            'readme_files': ['README.md', 'README.txt', 'README'],
            'source_directories': ['src', 'lib', 'include', 'source']
    
    def _load_browser_patterns(self):
            'browser_dirs': {
                'chrome': r'AppData\\Local\\Google\\Chrome',
                'edge': r'AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Edge',
                'firefox': r'AppData\\Roaming\\Mozilla\\Firefox'
            'download_patterns': [r'Downloads\\', r'Desktop\\', r'Documents\\']
    
    def _load_program_patterns(self):
        return {'install_dirs': [r'Program Files\\', r'AppData\\Local\\Programs']}
    
    def init_database(self):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)
        c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scanned_items (
            path TEXT UNIQUE, name TEXT, item_type TEXT, size_bytes INTEGER,
            file_count INTEGER, last_modified DATETIME, category TEXT, project_type TEXT,
            duplicate_hash TEXT, description TEXT)''')
        c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS file_types (
            item_id INTEGER, extension TEXT, count INTEGER, total_size INTEGER)''')
    
    def is_system_path(self, path):
        path_str = str(path).lower()
        for pattern in self.system_patterns['windows_dirs']:
            if re.match(pattern.lower(), path_str):
        for pattern in self.system_patterns['system_files']:
            if re.search(pattern.lower(), path_str):
    
    def scan_full_system(self):
        print("开始全面扫描...")
        results = {'projects': [], 'installed_programs': [], 'browser_data': [], 'downloads': [], 'user_folders': []}
        disks = [d.device for d in psutil.disk_partitions() if os.path.exists(d.mountpoint)]
        for disk in disks:
            print(f"扫描磁盘: {disk}")
            self.scan_directory(disk, results)
        self.save_to_database(results)
        report_path = self.generate_comprehensive_report(results)
        print(f"扫描完成，报告: {report_path}")
    
    def scan_directory(self, directory, results, depth=0, max_depth=8):
        if depth > max_depth or self.is_system_path(directory):
            for item in os.listdir(directory):
                item_path = os.path.join(directory, item)
                if self.is_system_path(item_path):
                if os.path.isdir(item_path):
                    cat = self.categorize_directory(item_path)
                    info = {'path': item_path, 'name': item, 'size': self.get_folder_size(item_path),
                            'file_count': self.count_files(item_path), 'last_modified': datetime.now(),
                            'category': cat, 'project_type': self.detect_project_type(item_path) if cat == 'project' else None}
                    results.setdefault(cat, []).append(info)
                    self.scan_directory(item_path, results, depth+1, max_depth)
        except (PermissionError, OSError):
            print(f"扫描 {directory} 出错: {e}")
    
    def categorize_directory(self, directory):
        if self.is_project_directory(directory): 
            return 'projects'
        if 'download' in str(directory).lower(): 
            return 'downloads'
        if 'users' in str(directory).lower(): 
            return 'user_folders'
        if 'browser' in str(directory).lower() or 'chrome' in str(directory).lower():
            return 'browser_data'
        return 'miscellaneous'
    
    def is_project_directory(self, directory):
            items = os.listdir(directory)
            for vc in self.project_patterns['version_control']:
                if vc in items: return True
            for cfg in self.project_patterns['config_files']:
                if cfg in items: return True
        except: return False
    
    def detect_project_type(self, directory):
            if '.git' in items:
                if 'package.json' in items: return 'Node.js Project'
                if 'requirements.txt' in items: return 'Python Project'
                if 'pom.xml' in items: return 'Java Maven Project'
                if 'build.gradle' in items: return 'Java Gradle Project'
                if 'Cargo.toml' in items: return 'Rust Project'
                if 'go.mod' in items: return 'Go Project'
                return 'Git Repository'
            return 'Unknown'
        except: return 'Unknown'
    
    def get_folder_size(self, path):
            for entry in os.scandir(path):
                if entry.is_file(): total += entry.stat().st_size
                elif entry.is_dir(): total += self.get_folder_size(entry.path)
        return total
    
    def count_files(self, path):
        count = 0
                if entry.is_file(): count += 1
                elif entry.is_dir(): count += self.count_files(entry.path)
        return count
    
    def save_to_database(self, results):
        for cat, items in results.items():
                    c.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO scanned_items (path, name, item_type, size_bytes, file_count, last_modified, category, project_type) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                             (item['path'], item['name'], 'directory', item['size'], item['file_count'], 
                              item['last_modified'].isoformat(), cat, item.get('project_type','')))
                    print(f"保存失败: {e}")
    
    def generate_comprehensive_report(self, results):
        report_file = f"scan_report_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.html"
        html = f"""
        <html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>系统扫描报告</title>
            body{{font-family:Arial;margin:20px}} 
            .stat{{background:#f0f8ff;padding:10px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:20px}}
            table{{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%}}
            th,td{{border:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;text-align:left}}
            th{{background-color:#4CAF50;color:white}}
        </head><body>
        <h1>🔍 完全系统扫描报告</h1>
        <p>生成时间: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}</p>
        <div class="stat">
            <h2>📊 统计摘要</h2>
            <p>项目数: {len(results.get('projects',[]))}</p>
            <p>总大小: {sum(i['size'] for i in results.get('projects',[]))/1e9:.2f} GB</p>
            <p>下载目录数: {len(results.get('downloads',[]))}</p>
        <h2>📁 项目列表</h2>
        <table>
        <tr><th>名称</th><th>类型</th><th>大小(MB)</th><th>路径</th></tr>
        for p in results.get('projects',[])[:100]:
            html += f"<tr><td>{p['name']}</td><td>{p.get('project_type','')}</td><td>{p['size']/1e6:.1f}</td><td>{p['path'][:80]}</td></tr>"
        html += "</table></body></html>"
        with open(report_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: 
            f.write(html)
        return report_file

    scanner = UltimateFileScanner()
    scanner.scan_full_system()
```


2️⃣ IDEProjectScanner.py – IDE项目与开发环境识别

```python
# IDEProjectScanner.py - 识别IDE项目、开发环境、Git仓库
import os, json, sqlite3, re

class IDEProjectScanner:
        self.ide_patterns = {
            'vscode': ['.vscode'], 'pycharm': ['.idea'], 'intellij': ['.idea'],
            'eclipse': ['.project', '.classpath'], 'android_studio': ['gradle', 'build.gradle']
        self.dev_env_patterns = {
            'nodejs': ['package.json', 'node_modules'], 'python': ['requirements.txt', 'venv'],
            'java': ['pom.xml', 'build.gradle'], 'go': ['go.mod'], 'rust': ['Cargo.toml'],
            'docker': ['Dockerfile', 'docker-compose.yml']
        self.git_patterns = ['.git']
        self.db_path = "projects_database.db"
        self.init_db()
    
    def init_db(self):
        c.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (
            name TEXT, path TEXT UNIQUE, project_type TEXT, ide_type TEXT, dev_env TEXT,
            size_mb REAL, last_modified DATETIME, importance_score INTEGER, tags TEXT)''')
    
    def scan_projects(self, root_paths=None):
        if not root_paths:
            root_paths = [str(Path.home()), 'D:\\', 'E:\\']
        projects = []
        for root in root_paths:
            if os.path.exists(root):
                    for item in os.listdir(root):
                        item_path = os.path.join(root, item)
                        if os.path.isdir(item_path) and self.is_project(item_path):
                            info = self.analyze_project(item_path)
                            projects.append(info)
                            self.save_project(info)
        return projects
    
    def is_project(self, path):
            items = os.listdir(path)
            for marker in self.git_patterns:
                if marker in items: return True
            for markers in self.dev_env_patterns.values():
                if any(m in items for m in markers): return True
    
    def analyze_project(self, path):
        name = os.path.basename(path)
        size = 0
                    size += os.path.getsize(os.path.join(root, f))
        size_mb = size / 1e6
        ide = None
        env = None
            for ide_name, markers in self.ide_patterns.items():
                if any(m in items for m in markers):
                    ide = ide_name
            for env_name, markers in self.dev_env_patterns.items():
                    env = env_name
        return {'name': name, 'path': path, 'project_type': env or 'unknown', 
                'ide_type': ide, 'size_mb': size_mb, 'last_modified': datetime.now()}
    
    def save_project(self, proj):
        c.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO projects (name, path, project_type, ide_type, size_mb, last_modified) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                 (proj['name'], proj['path'], proj['project_type'], proj['ide_type'], proj['size_mb'], proj['last_modified'].isoformat()))

    scanner = IDEProjectScanner()
    projects = scanner.scan_projects()
    print(f"发现 {len(projects)} 个项目")
```

3️⃣ SmartCleanupTool.py – 智能清理与重复文件处理（含合并）

```python
# SmartCleanupTool.py - 智能清理，自动备份，重复文件检测与合并
import os, shutil, zipfile, hashlib, sqlite3

class SmartCleanupTool:
        self.backup_dir = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser('~'), 'Cleanup_Backup')
        os.makedirs(self.backup_dir, exist_ok=True)
    
    def find_duplicate_files(self):
        """基于MD5哈希查找重复文件"""
        c.execute("SELECT path, size_bytes FROM scanned_items WHERE item_type='file'")
        files = c.fetchall()
        
        hash_map = defaultdict(list)
        for path, size in files:
            if os.path.exists(path) and size > 1024:
                        file_hash = hashlib.md5(f.read(1024*1024)).hexdigest()
                    hash_map[file_hash].append((path, size))
                except: continue
        return {h: lst for h, lst in hash_map.items() if len(lst) > 1}
    
    def merge_duplicate_files(self, duplicates, keep_original=True):
        """合并重复文件：保留一份，其余创建硬链接/符号链接或删除"""
        for file_hash, file_list in duplicates.items():
            keep_path = file_list[0][0]
            for dup_path, size in file_list[1:]:
                    if keep_original:
                        if os.name == 'nt':
                            # Windows 使用符号链接（需管理员权限，否则直接删除）
                                os.remove(dup_path)
                                os.symlink(keep_path, dup_path)
                            os.link(keep_path, dup_path)
                    merged.append({'deleted': dup_path, 'linked_to': keep_path, 'size': size})
                    print(f"合并失败 {dup_path}: {e}")
    
    def analyze_for_cleanup(self):
            c.execute("SELECT id, path, name, size_bytes, last_modified FROM scanned_items WHERE category='projects'")
            projects = c.fetchall()
        old_projects = []
        for r in projects:
                last_mod = datetime.fromisoformat(r[4])
                if (datetime.now() - last_mod).days > 180:
                    old_projects.append({'id':r[0],'path':r[1],'name':r[2],'size':r[3]})
        c.execute("SELECT id, path, name, size_bytes FROM scanned_items WHERE path LIKE '%Cache%' OR path LIKE '%Temp%'")
        caches = c.fetchall()
        cache_dirs = [{'id':r[0],'path':r[1],'size':r[3]} for r in caches]
        total_space = sum(p['size'] for p in old_projects) + sum(c['size'] for c in cache_dirs)
        return {'old_projects': old_projects, 'cache_dirs': cache_dirs}, total_space/1e9
    
    def compress_project(self, project_path, output_zip=None):
        if not output_zip:
            output_zip = project_path.rstrip('/\\') + f"_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(output_zip, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zipf:
                    arcname = os.path.relpath(file_path, project_path)
        shutil.rmtree(project_path)
        return output_zip
    
    def safe_cleanup(self, dry_run=False):
        candidates, space_gb = self.analyze_for_cleanup()
        print(f"预估可清理空间: {space_gb:.2f} GB")
        if dry_run:
            print("DRY RUN - 不会实际删除")
            return {'space_freed_gb': space_gb, 'merged_duplicates': 0}
        # 压缩旧项目
        for proj in candidates['old_projects']:
                self.compress_project(proj['path'])
                print(f"压缩: {proj['name']}")
                print(f"压缩失败 {proj['name']}: {e}")
        # 删除缓存
        for cache in candidates['cache_dirs']:
                shutil.rmtree(cache['path'], ignore_errors=True)
                print(f"删除缓存: {cache['path']}")
        # 合并重复文件
        duplicates = self.find_duplicate_files()
        merged = self.merge_duplicate_files(duplicates)
        print(f"合并重复文件: {len(merged)} 个，释放空间约 {sum(m['size'] for m in merged)/1e9:.2f} GB")
        return {'space_freed_gb': space_gb, 'merged_duplicates': len(merged)}

    tool = SmartCleanupTool()
    tool.safe_cleanup(dry_run=False)
```


4️⃣ DuplicateMerger.py – 按后缀名合并重复文件（独立强化版）

```python
# duplicate_merger.py - 完整合并相同后缀名文件，支持多种操作
import os, hashlib, shutil

class DuplicateMerger:
    def __init__(self, root_path=None):
        self.root_path = root_path or os.path.expanduser('~')
        self.ext_groups = defaultdict(list)
    
    def scan_by_extension(self):
        """按文件后缀名分组扫描"""
            # 跳过系统目录
            if any(skip in root for skip in ['Windows', 'Program Files', 'System32', '$Recycle']):
                ext = os.path.splitext(file)[1].lower()
                if ext:
                    self.ext_groups[ext].append(full_path)
        return self.ext_groups
    
    def find_duplicates_in_group(self, file_list):
        """在同一后缀名组内查找重复内容（基于MD5）"""
        for fpath in file_list:
                with open(fpath, 'rb') as f:
                    file_hash = hashlib.md5(f.read(8192)).hexdigest()
                hash_map[file_hash].append(fpath)
    
    def merge_all_duplicates(self, action='hardlink', dry_run=True):
        合并所有重复文件
        action: 'hardlink' (仅Unix), 'symlink', 'delete' (只保留第一个)
        self.scan_by_extension()
        total_saved = 0
        for ext, files in self.ext_groups.items():
            dup_groups = self.find_duplicates_in_group(files)
            for hash_val, dup_list in dup_groups.items():
                keep = dup_list[0]
                for dup in dup_list[1:]:
                        size = os.path.getsize(dup)
                        if not dry_run:
                            if action == 'hardlink' and os.name != 'nt':
                                os.unlink(dup)
                                os.link(keep, dup)
                            elif action == 'symlink':
                                os.symlink(keep, dup)
                            else:  # delete
                                os.remove(dup)
                        total_saved += size
                        results.append({'original': keep, 'duplicate': dup, 'size_mb': size/1e6})
                        print(f"处理 {dup} 失败: {e}")
        print(f"找到 {len(results)} 个重复文件，可节省 {total_saved/1e9:.2f} GB")
        return results, total_saved

    merger = DuplicateMerger()
    merger.merge_all_duplicates(action='symlink', dry_run=True)  # 先dry run
```

/**
 * 📊 系统日志记录器
 */
class SystemLogger {
    constructor(moduleName) {
        this.moduleName = moduleName;

    info(message, ...args) {
        console.log(`[INFO] ${new Date().toISOString()} - ${this.moduleName}: ${message}`, ...args);

    error(message, ...args) {
        console.error(`[ERROR] ${new Date().toISOString()} - ${this.moduleName}: ${message}`, ...args);

    warn(message, ...args) {
        console.warn(`[WARN] ${new Date().toISOString()} - ${this.moduleName}: ${message}`, ...args);

    debug(message, ...args) {
        console.debug(`[DEBUG] ${new Date().toISOString()} - ${this.moduleName}: ${message}`, ...args);

/**
 * 🔧 工具函数库
 */
class UtilityFunctions {
    static generateId(prefix = '') {
        return `${prefix}${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;

    static validateInput(input, maxLength = 5000) {
        if (!input || input.trim().length === 0) {
            throw new Error("输入内容不能为空");
        if (input.length > maxLength) {
            throw new Error(`输入内容长度不能超过${maxLength}字符`);
        
        // 安全检查
        const dangerousPatterns = [
            /<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi,
            /javascript:/gi,
            /on\w+\s*=/gi
        
        for (const pattern of dangerousPatterns) {
            if (pattern.test(input)) {
                throw new Error("检测到潜在的安全风险，输入包含可疑内容");
        
        return input.trim();

    static async sleep(ms) {
        return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

    static formatTimestamp(timestamp = Date.now()) {
        return new Date(timestamp).toISOString();

    static deepClone(obj) {
        return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj));

    static mergeObjects(target, source) {
        return { ...target, ...source };

    static calculateQualityScore(validationResult, executionTime, featuresCount) {
        let score = 100;
        
        // 基于验证结果扣分
        if (!validationResult.valid) {
            score -= 30;
        
        // 基于执行时间扣分（超过1秒开始扣分）
        if (executionTime > 1000) {
            score -= Math.min(20, (executionTime - 1000) / 100);
        
        // 基于功能数量加分
        score += Math.min(10, featuresCount * 0.5);
        
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(score)));

class NeuralDecisionSystem {
        this.logger = new SystemLogger('NeuralDecisionSystem');
        this.decisionPatterns = this.initializeDecisionPatterns();

    initializeDecisionPatterns() {
            // 意图识别模式
            intentPatterns: {
                coze_repair: /(修复|错误|问题|解决|修正|连接|断开|失败|异常)/,
                workflow_generation: /(创建|生成|建立|构建|工作流|流程|自动化)/,
                analysis: /(分析|报告|统计|趋势|研究|评估|检查)/,
                optimization: /(优化|改进|提升|增强|效率|性能|加速)/,
                integration: /(集成|连接|整合|合并|统一|协调)/,
                deployment: /(部署|发布|上线|安装|配置)/,
                testing: /(测试|验证|检查|调试|排查)/,
                security: /(安全|防护|保护|加密|认证)/,
                monitoring: /(监控|监测|观察|追踪|日志)/,
                backup: /(备份|恢复|还原|存档)/
            
            // 优先级评估规则
            priorityRules: {
                high: [/紧急/, /立刻/, /马上/, /尽快/, /崩溃/, /无法使用/],
                medium: [/重要/, /需要/, /应当/, /建议/],
                low: [/优化/, /改进/, /增强/, /未来/]
            
            // 复杂度评估规则
            complexityRules: {
                high: [/.{100,}/, /多个/, /复杂/, /系统/],
                medium: [/.{50,100}/, /几个/, /中等/],
                low: [/.{1,50}/, /简单/, /基础/]

    async analyzeInput(userInput, context = {}) {
        this.logger.info(`开始分析用户输入: ${userInput.substring(0, 100)}...`);
        
        const analysisStartTime = Date.now();
        
            // 1. 意图识别
            const intents = this.detectIntents(userInput);
            
            // 2. 优先级评估
            const priority = this.assessPriority(userInput);
            
            // 3. 复杂度评估
            const complexity = this.assessComplexity(userInput);
            
            // 4. 上下文分析
            const contextAnalysis = await this.analyzeContext(context, intents);
            
            // 5. 生成决策
            const decision = await this.generateDecision(intents, priority, complexity, contextAnalysis);
            
            const analysisTime = Date.now() - analysisStartTime;
            
            this.logger.info(`分析完成，识别到意图: ${intents.join(', ')}，耗时: ${analysisTime}ms`);
            
                intents: intents,
                primary_intent: intents[0] || 'general_automation',
                priority: priority,
                complexity: complexity,
                context_analysis: contextAnalysis,
                decision: decision,
                confidence: this.calculateConfidence(intents, contextAnalysis),
                analysis_time: analysisTime,
                timestamp: UtilityFunctions.formatTimestamp()
            
            this.logger.error(`输入分析失败: ${error}`);

    detectIntents(userInput) {
        const detectedIntents = [];
        
        for (const [intent, pattern] of Object.entries(this.decisionPatterns.intentPatterns)) {
            if (pattern.test(userInput)) {
                detectedIntents.push(intent);
        
        // 如果没有检测到特定意图，使用通用自动化
        if (detectedIntents.length === 0) {
            detectedIntents.push('general_automation');
        
        return detectedIntents;

    assessPriority(userInput) {
        for (const [priority, patterns] of Object.entries(this.decisionPatterns.priorityRules)) {
                    return priority;
        return 'medium';

    assessComplexity(userInput) {
        const length = userInput.length;
        const wordCount = userInput.split(/\s+/).length;
        
        for (const [complexity, patterns] of Object.entries(this.decisionPatterns.complexityRules)) {
                    return complexity;
        
        if (length > 100 || wordCount > 20) return 'high';
        if (length > 50 || wordCount > 10) return 'medium';
        return 'low';

    async analyzeContext(context, intents) {
        const contextAnalysis = {
            user_preferences: context.user_preferences || {},
            system_resources: context.system_resources || {},
            historical_data: context.historical_data || {},
            environment: context.environment || 'production'

        // 基于意图的上下文增强
        if (intents.includes('coze_repair')) {
            contextAnalysis.repair_context = {
                coze_components: this.identifyCozeComponents(context),
                common_issues: await this.getCommonCozeIssues()

        if (intents.includes('workflow_generation')) {
            contextAnalysis.workflow_context = {
                template_library: await this.getWorkflowTemplates(),
                best_practices: await this.getWorkflowBestPractices()

        return contextAnalysis;

    identifyCozeComponents(context) {
        // 识别Coze平台相关组件
        const components = [];
        
        if (context.user_input && context.user_input.includes('插件')) {
            components.push('plugins');
        if (context.user_input && context.user_input.includes('工作流')) {
            components.push('workflows');
        if (context.user_input && context.user_input.includes('节点')) {
            components.push('nodes');
        if (context.user_input && context.user_input.includes('参数')) {
            components.push('parameters');
        
        return components.length > 0 ? components : ['general'];

    async getCommonCozeIssues() {
        // 模拟获取常见的Coze问题
        await UtilityFunctions.sleep(50);
        
            "节点连接失败",
            "参数配置错误", 
            "插件兼容性问题",
            "工作流执行超时",
            "权限配置错误"

    async getWorkflowTemplates() {
        // 模拟获取工作流模板
        
            "data_processing": "数据处理工作流",
            "api_integration": "API集成工作流", 
            "error_handling": "错误处理工作流",
            "scheduled_tasks": "定时任务工作流"

    async getWorkflowBestPractices() {
        // 模拟获取工作流最佳实践
        
            "使用错误处理节点捕获异常",
            "合理设置超时时间",
            "使用参数验证确保输入正确",
            "实现适当的重试机制"

    async generateDecision(intents, priority, complexity, contextAnalysis) {
        const decisionMatrix = {
            coze_repair: {
                recommended_actions: [
                    "执行错误检测和诊断",
                    "自动修复节点连接问题",
                    "校正参数配置",
                    "验证修复结果"
                required_functions: ["error_detection", "connection_repair", "parameter_correction"],
                estimated_time: complexity === 'high' ? "5-10分钟" : "2-5分钟",
                risk_level: "低"
            workflow_generation: {
                    "分析需求并设计工作流结构",
                    "生成工作流节点",
                    "建立节点连接",
                    "配置参数和验证规则"
                required_functions: ["workflow_design", "node_generation", "connection_establishment"],
                estimated_time: complexity === 'high' ? "10-15分钟" : "5-8分钟", 
                risk_level: "中"
            analysis: {
                    "收集和分析相关数据",
                    "生成分析报告",
                    "提供洞察和建议",
                    "创建可视化图表"
                required_functions: ["data_collection", "analysis_engine", "report_generation"],
                estimated_time: "3-7分钟",
            general_automation: {
                    "执行通用自动化处理",
                    "应用智能优化算法",
                    "生成综合处理报告",
                    "提供改进建议"
                required_functions: ["general_processing", "optimization", "reporting"],
                estimated_time: "2-5分钟",

        const primaryIntent = intents[0];
        const baseDecision = decisionMatrix[primaryIntent] || decisionMatrix.general_automation;
        
        // 根据优先级和复杂度调整决策
        const adjustedDecision = this.adjustDecisionByPriorityAndComplexity(
            baseDecision, priority, complexity

            ...adjustedDecision,
            intent_based: true,
            supporting_intents: intents.slice(1),
            context_aware: true,
            adaptive: true

    adjustDecisionByPriorityAndComplexity(baseDecision, priority, complexity) {
        const adjusted = UtilityFunctions.deepClone(baseDecision);
        
        // 根据优先级调整
        if (priority === 'high') {
            adjusted.recommended_actions.unshift("立即执行紧急处理");
            adjusted.estimated_time = this.adjustTimeForPriority(adjusted.estimated_time, 'high');
            adjusted.risk_level = this.adjustRiskForPriority(adjusted.risk_level, 'high');
        
        // 根据复杂度调整
        if (complexity === 'high') {
            adjusted.recommended_actions.push("执行深度分析和优化");
            adjusted.required_functions.push("deep_analysis", "advanced_optimization");
        
        return adjusted;

    adjustTimeForPriority(originalTime, priority) {
        const timeMap = {
            high: { "2-5分钟": "1-3分钟", "5-8分钟": "3-5分钟", "10-15分钟": "5-8分钟" },
            medium: { "2-5分钟": "2-5分钟", "5-8分钟": "5-8分钟", "10-15分钟": "8-12分钟" },
            low: { "2-5分钟": "3-6分钟", "5-8分钟": "6-10分钟", "10-15分钟": "12-18分钟" }
        
        return timeMap[priority]?.[originalTime] || originalTime;

    adjustRiskForPriority(originalRisk, priority) {
        if (priority === 'high' && originalRisk === '低') return '中';
        if (priority === 'high' && originalRisk === '中') return '高';
        return originalRisk;

    calculateConfidence(intents, contextAnalysis) {
        let confidence = 0.7; // 基础置信度
        
        // 基于意图数量调整
        if (intents.length === 1) confidence += 0.1;
        if (intents.length >= 3) confidence -= 0.1;
        
        // 基于上下文完整性调整
        if (contextAnalysis.user_preferences) confidence += 0.05;
        if (contextAnalysis.system_resources) confidence += 0.05;
        if (contextAnalysis.historical_data) confidence += 0.1;
        
        return Math.min(Math.max(confidence, 0.1), 0.95);

    async validateDecision(decision, originalInput) {
        const validation = {
        
        if (!decision.recommended_actions || decision.recommended_actions.length === 0) {
            validation.valid = false;
            validation.warnings.push("决策缺少推荐操作");
        
        if (!decision.required_functions || decision.required_functions.length === 0) {
            validation.warnings.push("决策缺少必要功能模块");
        
        if (decision.risk_level === '高') {
            validation.suggestions.push("高风险操作，建议用户确认");
        
        return validation;

// 模块 2: 错误自动检测修复系统
