```javascript
// ==================== 通信总线系统 ====================
class CommunicationBus {
    this.emitter = new EventEmitter();
    this.messageQueue = new Map();
    this.messageHistory = [];
    this.connectedModules = new Set();
    
    this.MESSAGE_TYPES = {
      LEARNING_START: 'learning_start',
      LEARNING_DATA: 'learning_data',
      LEARNING_COMPLETE: 'learning_complete',
      ANALYSIS_START: 'analysis_start',
      ANALYSIS_RESULT: 'analysis_result',
      ANALYSIS_COMPLETE: 'analysis_complete',
      MODULE_REGISTER: 'module_register',
      MODULE_READY: 'module_ready',
      MODULE_ERROR: 'module_error',
      SECURITY_CHECK: 'security_check',
      SECURITY_VALIDATION: 'security_validation',
      SECURITY_ALERT: 'security_alert',
      CONVERSION_START: 'conversion_start',
      CONVERSION_PROGRESS: 'conversion_progress',
      CONVERSION_COMPLETE: 'conversion_complete',
      TRAE_CN_EVENT: 'trae_cn_event',
      WEBHOOK_RECEIVED: 'webhook_received',
      AUTOMATION_TRIGGER: 'automation_trigger'
  
  registerModule(moduleName) {
    this.connectedModules.add(moduleName);
    const message = {
      type: this.MESSAGE_TYPES.MODULE_REGISTER,
      data: { moduleName, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
      source: 'communication_bus',
      target: 'all'
    this.broadcast(message);
    return message;
  
  sendMessage(type, data, source, target) {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      type,
      source,
      target,
      signature: this.signMessage(data)
    this.messageHistory.push(message);
    if (target === 'all') this.broadcast(message);
    else this.emitter.emit(`message:${target}`, message);
    this.logMessage(message);
  
  broadcast(message) { this.emitter.emit('message:broadcast', message); }
  subscribe(target, callback) {
    if (target === 'all') this.emitter.on('message:broadcast', callback);
    else this.emitter.on(`message:${target}`, callback);
  
  signMessage(data) { return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(data)).digest('hex'); }
  
  logMessage(message) {
    const logEntry = { timestamp: message.timestamp, messageId: message.id, type: message.type, source: message.source, target: message.target, dataSize: JSON.stringify(message.data).length };
    fs.ensureDirSync('./logs');
    fs.appendFileSync('./logs/communication.log', JSON.stringify(logEntry) + '\n');
  
  getModuleStatus() { return { connectedModules: Array.from(this.connectedModules), totalMessages: this.messageHistory.length, lastMessage: this.messageHistory[this.messageHistory.length-1] }; }

// ==================== 资源调用引擎 ====================
class ResourceCallEngine {
  constructor(bus) { this.bus = bus; this.callResults = new Map(); this.callHistory = []; }
  
  async callDeepSeekFiles(folderPath) {
    const results = []; const sessionId = crypto.randomUUID();
    this.bus.sendMessage('learning_start', { target: 'deepseek_files', path: folderPath }, 'call_engine', 'learning_module');
    if (fs.existsSync(folderPath)) {
      const files = fs.readdirSync(folderPath);
        const filePath = path.join(folderPath, file);
        const stats = fs.statSync(filePath);
        if (stats.isFile() && stats.size < CONFIG.security.maxFileSize) {
            const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');
            const result = { type: 'deepseek_file', name: file, path: filePath, size: stats.size, modified: stats.mtime, content, contentType: this.detectContentType(content), patterns: this.extractPatterns(content), sessionId, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
            this.bus.sendMessage('learning_data', result, 'call_engine', 'learning_module');
          } catch(e) { console.error(`读取文件错误 ${filePath}:`, e.message); }
    this.callResults.set(sessionId, results);
    this.callHistory.push({ type: 'deepseek_files', sessionId, count: results.length, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
    this.bus.sendMessage('learning_complete', { sessionId, count: results.length }, 'call_engine', 'learning_module');
  
  async callWebResource(url) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const req = https.get(url, (res) => {
        let data = '';
        res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
        res.on('end', () => {
          const result = { type: 'web_resource', url, statusCode: res.statusCode, headers: res.headers, content: data, contentLength: data.length, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
          resolve(result);
      req.on('error', (error) => resolve({ type: 'web_resource', url, error: error.message, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }));
      req.setTimeout(30000, () => { req.destroy(); resolve({ type: 'web_resource', url, error: '请求超时', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }); });
  
  async callAPI(name, endpoint, apiKey = null) {
      const result = { type: 'api_call', name, endpoint, called: true, authenticated: !!apiKey, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
    } catch(error) { return { type: 'api_call', name, endpoint, error: error.message, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; }
  
  detectContentType(content) {
    if (content.includes('<html>') || content.includes('<!DOCTYPE html>')) return 'html';
    if (content.trim().startsWith('{') || content.trim().startsWith('[')) try { JSON.parse(content); return 'json'; } catch(e) { return 'text'; }
    if (content.includes('function') || content.includes('const ') || content.includes('let ') || content.includes('var ')) return 'javascript';
    if (content.includes('import ') || content.includes('from ')) return 'es6_module';
    if (content.includes('def ') || content.includes('import ')) return 'python';
    return 'text';
  
  extractPatterns(content) {
    const patterns = [];
    if (/function\(|=>/.test(content)) patterns.push('function_definitions');
    if (/class |interface /.test(content)) patterns.push('class_definitions');
    if (/import |require\(/.test(content)) patterns.push('import_statements');
    if (/export |module\.exports/.test(content)) patterns.push('export_statements');
    if (/https?:\/\//.test(content)) patterns.push('url_references');
    if (/@\w+\.\w+/.test(content)) patterns.push('email_addresses');
    if (/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(content)) patterns.push('date_formats');
    if (/# |## /.test(content)) patterns.push('markdown_headers');
    if (/^- |^\* /.test(content)) patterns.push('list_items');
    return patterns;

// ==================== 学习引擎 ====================
class LearningEngine {
  constructor(bus) {
    this.bus = bus; this.knowledgeBase = new Map(); this.learnedPatterns = []; this.learningSessions = new Map();
    bus.registerModule('learning_module');
    bus.subscribe('learning_module', (message) => this.handleLearningMessage(message));
  
  async handleLearningMessage(message) {
    switch(message.type) {
      case 'learning_start': await this.startLearningSession(message.data); break;
      case 'learning_data': await this.processLearningData(message.data); break;
      case 'learning_complete': await this.completeLearningSession(message.data); break;
  
  async startLearningSession(data) {
    const sessionId = data.sessionId || crypto.randomUUID();
    this.learningSessions.set(sessionId, { startTime: new Date().toISOString(), dataCount: 0, patterns: [], insights: [] });
    this.bus.sendMessage('module_ready', { module: 'learning', sessionId }, 'learning_module', data.source || 'all');
    return sessionId;
  
  async processLearningData(data) {
    const sessionId = data.sessionId;
    let session = this.learningSessions.get(sessionId);
    if (!session) { await this.startLearningSession({ sessionId }); session = this.learningSessions.get(sessionId); }
    const analysis = this.analyzeContent(data);
    const patterns = this.extractLearningPatterns(data, analysis);
    const insights = this.generateInsights(data, analysis, patterns);
    const knowledgeId = `knowledge_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0,8)}`;
    const knowledge = { id: knowledgeId, source: data, analysis, patterns, insights, sessionId, learnedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    this.knowledgeBase.set(knowledgeId, knowledge);
    this.learnedPatterns.push(...patterns);
    session.dataCount++; session.patterns.push(...patterns); session.insights.push(...insights);
    this.bus.sendMessage('analysis_result', { knowledgeId, analysis, patterns, insights }, 'learning_module', 'analysis_module');
    return knowledge;
  
  analyzeContent(data) {
    const analysis = { contentType: data.contentType || 'unknown', size: data.size || 0, complexity: 'low', structure: {}, entities: [] };
    if (data.content) {
      const lines = data.content.split('\n').length, words = data.content.split(/\s+/).length;
      analysis.complexity = (lines>100||words>1000)?'high':(lines>20||words>200)?'medium':'low';
      if (analysis.contentType === 'html') analysis.structure = this.analyzeHTMLStructure(data.content);
      else if (analysis.contentType === 'javascript') analysis.structure = this.analyzeCodeStructure(data.content);
      analysis.entities = this.extractEntities(data.content);
  
  analyzeHTMLStructure(html) {
    return { hasHead: html.includes('<head'), hasBody: html.includes('<body'), scripts: (html.match(/<script/g)||[]).length, styles: (html.match(/<style/g)||[]).length, links: (html.match(/<a\s+href/g)||[]).length, images: (html.match(/<img/g)||[]).length, forms: (html.match(/<form/g)||[]).length };
  
  analyzeCodeStructure(code) {
    return { functions: (code.match(/function\s+\w+|const\s+\w+\s*=\s*\(|let\s+\w+\s*=\s*\(/g)||[]).length, classes: (code.match(/class\s+\w+/g)||[]).length, imports: (code.match(/import\s+.*from|require\(/g)||[]).length, exports: (code.match(/export\s+|module\.exports/g)||[]).length, comments: (code.match(/\/\/|\/\*|\*/g)||[]).length };
  
  extractEntities(content) {
    const entities = [];
    const urlRegex = /https?:\/\/[^\s"']+/g; const urls = content.match(urlRegex);
    if (urls) urls.forEach(url => entities.push({ type: 'url', value: url }));
    const emailRegex = /\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b/g; const emails = content.match(emailRegex);
    if (emails) emails.forEach(email => entities.push({ type: 'email', value: email }));
    const codeRegex = /`{3}([\s\S]*?)`{3}|`([^`]+)`/g; let match;
    while ((match = codeRegex.exec(content)) !== null) entities.push({ type: 'code_snippet', value: match[1]||match[2], length: (match[1]||match[2]).length });
    return entities;
  
  extractLearningPatterns(data, analysis) {
    const patterns = [`content_type:${analysis.contentType}`, `complexity:${analysis.complexity}`];
    if (analysis.structure.scripts > 0) patterns.push('has_javascript');
    if (analysis.structure.forms > 0) patterns.push('has_forms');
    if (analysis.entities.some(e=>e.type==='url')) patterns.push('has_external_links');
    if (data.type === 'deepseek_file') patterns.push('source:deepseek');
    if (data.type === 'web_resource') patterns.push('source:web');
    if (data.type === 'api_call') patterns.push('source:api');
  
  generateInsights(data, analysis, patterns) {
    if (patterns.includes('has_javascript')) insights.push('此资源包含JavaScript代码，可能具有交互功能');
    if (patterns.includes('has_external_links')) insights.push('包含外部链接，可能需要网络访问');
    if (analysis.complexity === 'high') insights.push('内容复杂度较高，可能需要分步处理');
    if (data.content && data.content.length > 10000) insights.push('内容较大，建议分段处理或优化存储');
  
  async completeLearningSession(data) {
    const session = this.learningSessions.get(sessionId);
    if (session) {
      session.endTime = new Date().toISOString();
      session.duration = new Date(session.endTime) - new Date(session.startTime);
      const summary = { sessionId, startTime: session.startTime, endTime: session.endTime, duration: session.duration, dataCount: session.dataCount, uniquePatterns: [...new Set(session.patterns)], totalInsights: session.insights.length, knowledgeGenerated: this.countKnowledgeBySession(sessionId) };
      this.learningSessions.set(sessionId, { ...session, summary });
      this.bus.sendMessage('learning_complete', summary, 'learning_module', 'all');
  
  countKnowledgeBySession(sessionId) { let count=0; for(const [_,k] of this.knowledgeBase) if(k.sessionId===sessionId) count++; return count; }
  getKnowledgeSummary() { return { totalKnowledge: this.knowledgeBase.size, totalPatterns: this.learnedPatterns.length, uniquePatterns: [...new Set(this.learnedPatterns)], activeSessions: this.learningSessions.size, lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString() }; }

// ==================== 分析引擎 ====================
class AnalysisEngine {
    this.bus = bus; this.analysisResults = new Map(); this.toolRecommendations = [];
    bus.registerModule('analysis_module');
    bus.subscribe('analysis_module', async (message) => this.handleAnalysisMessage(message));
  async handleAnalysisMessage(message) {
    if (message.type === 'analysis_result') await this.analyzeKnowledge(message.data);
    if (message.type === 'security_check') await this.securityAnalysis(message.data);
  async analyzeKnowledge(data) {
    const { knowledgeId, analysis, patterns, insights } = data;
    const toolRecommendations = this.generateToolRecommendations(analysis, patterns);
    const potentialFunctions = this.identifyPotentialFunctions(analysis, patterns);
    const conversionDifficulty = this.evaluateConversionDifficulty(analysis);
    const analysisResult = { knowledgeId, toolRecommendations, potentialFunctions, conversionDifficulty, patterns, insights, analyzedAt: new Date().toISOString(), confidence: this.calculateConfidence(analysis, patterns) };
    this.analysisResults.set(knowledgeId, analysisResult);
    this.bus.sendMessage('analysis_complete', analysisResult, 'analysis_module', 'conversion_module');
    return analysisResult;
  generateToolRecommendations(analysis, patterns) {
    if (analysis.contentType === 'html') recommendations.push({ name: 'html_parser', description: 'HTML解析和内容提取工具', priority: 'high', reason: '检测到HTML内容' });
    if (analysis.contentType === 'javascript') recommendations.push({ name: 'code_analyzer', description: 'JavaScript代码分析工具', priority: 'high', reason: '检测到JavaScript代码' });
    if (patterns.includes('has_external_links')) recommendations.push({ name: 'link_validator', description: '链接验证和检查工具', priority: 'medium', reason: '检测到外部链接' });
    if (patterns.includes('has_forms')) recommendations.push({ name: 'form_processor', description: '表单数据处理工具', priority: 'medium', reason: '检测到表单元素' });
    if (analysis.complexity === 'high') recommendations.push({ name: 'chunk_processor', description: '大内容分块处理工具', priority: 'high', reason: '内容复杂度高' });
    recommendations.push({ name: 'data_converter', description: '通用数据格式转换器', priority: 'low', reason: '通用功能' }, { name: 'file_organizer', description: '文件组织和整理工具', priority: 'low', reason: '通用功能' });
  identifyPotentialFunctions(analysis, patterns) {
    if (analysis.contentType === 'html') { functions.push({ name: 'extract_text_from_html', description: '从HTML提取纯文本', input: 'html_content', output: 'plain_text' }); functions.push({ name: 'extract_links_from_html', description: '提取HTML中所有链接', input: 'html_content', output: 'link_list' }); }
    if (analysis.contentType === 'javascript') { functions.push({ name: 'analyze_dependencies', description: '分析JavaScript依赖关系', input: 'javascript_code', output: 'dependency_graph' }); functions.push({ name: 'extract_functions', description: '提取JavaScript函数定义', input: 'javascript_code', output: 'function_list' }); }
    if (patterns.includes('has_external_links')) functions.push({ name: 'validate_urls', description: '验证URL可访问性', input: 'url_list', output: 'validation_report' });
  evaluateConversionDifficulty(analysis) { const typeDiff = { 'html':3, 'javascript':4, 'json':2, 'text':1, 'unknown':5 }; let score = typeDiff[analysis.contentType]||5; if(analysis.complexity==='high') score+=3; else if(analysis.complexity==='medium') score+=2; if(analysis.structure && Object.keys(analysis.structure).length>3) score+=2; return score<=3?'easy':score<=6?'medium':'hard'; }
  calculateConfidence(analysis, patterns) { let confidence=70; if(analysis.contentType!=='unknown') confidence+=10; confidence+=Math.min(patterns.length*2,20); if(analysis.structure && Object.keys(analysis.structure).length>0) confidence+=10; return Math.min(confidence,100); }
  async securityAnalysis(data) {
    const securityReport = { timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), checks: [], issues: [], recommendations: [], score: 100 };
    if (data.content && this.containsMaliciousPatterns(data.content)) { securityReport.issues.push('检测到可疑代码模式'); securityReport.score -= 30; }
    if (data.content && this.containsSensitiveData(data.content)) { securityReport.issues.push('检测到敏感数据'); securityReport.score -= 20; }
    if (data.content && this.hasExternalDependencies(data.content)) { securityReport.checks.push('有外部依赖'); securityReport.recommendations.push('验证外部依赖的安全性'); }
    securityReport.passed = securityReport.score >= 70;
    this.bus.sendMessage('security_validation', securityReport, 'analysis_module', 'conversion_module');
    return securityReport;
  containsMaliciousPatterns(content) { return /eval\(|exec\(|system\(|shell_exec\(|passthru\(/i.test(content)); }
  containsSensitiveData(content) { return /password\s*=\s*['"][^'"]+['"]|api[_-]?key\s*=\s*['"][^'"]+['"]|secret\s*=\s*['"][^'"]+['"]|token\s*=\s*['"][^'"]+['"]|private[_-]?key/i.test(content); }
  hasExternalDependencies(content) { return /https?:\/\/(?!localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)|require\(['"][^'"]+['"]\)|import\s+.*from\s+['"][^'"]+['"]/i.test(content); }

// ==================== 转换引擎 ====================
class ConversionEngine {
    this.bus = bus; this.convertedTools = new Map(); this.toolConfigs = new Map();
    bus.registerModule('conversion_module');
    bus.subscribe('conversion_module', async (message) => this.handleConversionMessage(message));
  async handleConversionMessage(message) {
    if (message.type === 'analysis_complete') await this.convertToMCP(message.data);
    if (message.type === 'security_validation') await this.applySecurity(message.data);
  async convertToMCP(analysisData) {
    const { knowledgeId, toolRecommendations, potentialFunctions } = analysisData;
    this.bus.sendMessage('conversion_start', { knowledgeId, toolCount: toolRecommendations.length }, 'conversion_module', 'all');
    const convertedTools = [], toolConfigs = [];
    for (const [index, tool] of toolRecommendations.entries()) {
        const converted = await this.convertSingleTool(tool, potentialFunctions, index);
        convertedTools.push(converted);
        toolConfigs.push(this.generateMCPConfig(converted));
        this.bus.sendMessage('conversion_progress', { current: index+1, total: toolRecommendations.length, toolName: tool.name, status: 'success' }, 'conversion_module', 'all');
      } catch(error) { this.bus.sendMessage('conversion_progress', { current: index+1, total: toolRecommendations.length, toolName: tool.name, status: 'failed', error: error.message }, 'conversion_module', 'all'); }
    const combinedTools = await this.generateCombinedTools(convertedTools);
    convertedTools.push(...combinedTools);
    const unifiedMCP = await this.createUnifiedMCP(convertedTools, toolConfigs);
    const conversionResult = { knowledgeId, convertedTools: convertedTools.length, toolConfigs: toolConfigs.length, combinedTools: combinedTools.length, unifiedMCP, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
    this.convertedTools.set(knowledgeId, conversionResult);
    this.bus.sendMessage('conversion_complete', conversionResult, 'conversion_module', 'all');
    return conversionResult;
  async convertSingleTool(tool, potentialFunctions, index) {
    const toolId = `mcp_${tool.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '_')}_${index}`;
    const implementation = this.generateToolImplementation(tool, potentialFunctions);
    const config = { name: toolId, version: '1.0.0', description: tool.description, category: this.categorizeTool(tool), priority: tool.priority, inputSchema: this.generateInputSchema(tool), outputSchema: this.generateOutputSchema(tool), dependencies: this.identifyToolDependencies(tool) };
    return { id: toolId, name: tool.name, config, implementation, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
  generateToolImplementation(tool, potentialFunctions) { return `// ${tool.name} - MCP工具实现\n// 生成时间: ${new Date().toISOString()}\n\nconst ${tool.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_')} = {\n  name: '${tool.name}',\n  version: '1.0.0',\n  async execute(args) {\n    try {\n      ${this.generateInputValidation(tool)}\n      const result = await this.process(args);\n      const formattedResult = this.formatResult(result);\n      return { success: true, data: formattedResult, metadata: { processedAt: new Date().toISOString(), tool: '${tool.name}', args } };\n    } catch (error) { return { success: false, error: error.message, stack: error.stack, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; }\n  },\n  async process(args) { ${this.generateProcessLogic(tool, potentialFunctions)} return { processed: true, tool: '${tool.name}' }; },\n  formatResult(result) { return { ...result, formatted: true, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; }\n};\n\nmodule.exports = ${tool.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_')};`; }
  generateInputValidation(tool) { if(tool.name.includes('html')||tool.name.includes('web')) return `if (!args.url && !args.html) throw new Error('需要提供URL或HTML内容'); if (args.url && !args.url.startsWith('http')) throw new Error('URL格式不正确');`; if(tool.name.includes('file')||tool.name.includes('path')) return `if (!args.path) throw new Error('需要提供文件路径'); const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync(args.path)) throw new Error('文件不存在: ' + args.path);`; return `if (!args) throw new Error('需要提供输入参数');`; }
  generateProcessLogic(tool, potentialFunctions) { if(tool.name.includes('html_parser')) return `const cheerio = require('cheerio'); if (args.url) { const response = await fetch(args.url); const html = await response.text(); const $ = cheerio.load(html); const text = $('body').text().replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const links = []; $('a[href]').each((i,elem)=>{ links.push({ text: $(elem).text().trim(), href: $(elem).attr('href') }); }); return { text, links, url: args.url }; } else if (args.html) { const $ = cheerio.load(args.html); const text = $('body').text().replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const links = []; $('a[href]').each((i,elem)=>{ links.push({ text: $(elem).text().trim(), href: $(elem).attr('href') }); }); return { text, links }; }`; if(tool.name.includes('code_analyzer')) return `let code = args.code; if (!code && args.path) code = fs.readFileSync(args.path, 'utf-8'); const functions = (code.match(/function\\s+\\w+|const\\s+\\w+\\s*=\\s*\\(|let\\s+\\w+\\s*=\\s*\\(|\\w+\\s*\\([^)]*\\)\\s*=>/g)||[]).length; const imports = (code.match(/import\\s+.*from\\s+['"][^'"]+['"]|require\\(['"][^'"]+['"]\\)/g)||[]).length; return { functions, imports, codeLength: code.length, lines: code.split('\\n').length };`; return `return { input: args, processed: true, tool: '${tool.name}' };`; }
  categorizeTool(tool) { if(tool.name.includes('html')||tool.name.includes('web')) return 'web_processing'; if(tool.name.includes('code')||tool.name.includes('script')) return 'code_analysis'; if(tool.name.includes('file')||tool.name.includes('path')) return 'file_processing'; if(tool.name.includes('data')||tool.name.includes('convert')) return 'data_processing'; return 'general'; }
  generateInputSchema(tool) { const schema = { type: 'object', properties: {}, required: [] }; if(tool.category === 'web_processing') schema.properties = { url: { type: 'string', description: '网页URL' }, html: { type: 'string', description: 'HTML内容' }, extractText: { type: 'boolean', default: true }, extractLinks: { type: 'boolean', default: true } }; else if(tool.category === 'code_analysis') schema.properties = { code: { type: 'string', description: '代码内容' }, path: { type: 'string', description: '代码文件路径' }, analyzeDependencies: { type: 'boolean', default: true } }; else schema.properties = { input: { type: 'string', description: '输入数据' }, options: { type: 'object', description: '处理选项' } }; return schema; }
  generateOutputSchema(tool) { return { type: 'object', properties: { success: { type: 'boolean' }, data: { type: 'object' }, error: { type: 'string' }, timestamp: { type: 'string' } } }; }
  identifyToolDependencies(tool) { const deps = []; if(tool.category === 'web_processing') deps.push('cheerio','axios'); if(tool.category === 'code_analysis') deps.push('@babel/parser','@babel/traverse'); return deps; }
  generateMCPConfig(tool) { return { mcpServers: { [tool.config.name]: { command: "node", args: [`./tools/${tool.config.name}.js`], env: { NODE_ENV: "production", TOOL_NAME: tool.config.name } } } }; }
  async generateCombinedTools(tools) { const combinedTools = []; const byCategory = {}; tools.forEach(t=>{ if(!byCategory[t.config.category]) byCategory[t.config.category]=[]; byCategory[t.config.category].push(t); }); for(const [category, categoryTools] of Object.entries(byCategory)) { if(categoryTools.length>1) { const combinedTool = { id: `mcp_${category}_suite`, name: `${category}工具套件`, config: { name: `${category}_suite`, version: '1.0.0', description: `${category}相关工具套件`, category: 'suite', contains: categoryTools.map(t=>t.config.name) }, implementation: this.generateSuiteImplementation(category, categoryTools), generatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }; combinedTools.push(combinedTool); } } return combinedTools; }
  generateSuiteImplementation(category, tools) { return `// ${category}工具套件\nconst ${category.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_')}_suite = {\n  name: '${category}_suite',\n  version: '1.0.0',\n  tools: {\n    ${tools.map(tool=>`'${tool.config.name}': { execute: async (args) => { return { tool: '${tool.config.name}', category: '${category}', result: '通过套件执行', args }; } }`).join(',\n    ')}\n  },\n  async execute(toolName, args) { if (this.tools[toolName]) return await this.tools[toolName].execute(args); else throw new Error('工具不存在: ' + toolName); },\n  listTools() { return Object.keys(this.tools); }\n};\n\nmodule.exports = ${category.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_')}_suite;`; }
  async createUnifiedMCP(tools, configs) { const unifiedConfig = { name: 'omnimcp_unified_tools', version: CONFIG.version, description: 'OmniMCP统一工具集', tools: tools.map(t=>({ name: t.config.name, description: t.config.description, category: t.config.category })), configs, security: { enabled: true, validation: 'strict', encryption: CONFIG.security.encryption }, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }; const serverCode = this.generateUnifiedMCPServer(tools); return { config: unifiedConfig, serverCode, toolsCount: tools.length }; }
  generateUnifiedMCPServer(tools) { return `// OmniMCP统一服务器\nconst { Server } = require('@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/index.js');\nconst { StdioServerTransport } = require('@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/stdio.js');\n\nclass UnifiedMCPServer {\n  constructor() {\n    this.server = new Server({ name: 'omnimcp-unified', version: '${CONFIG.version}', description: 'OmniMCP统一工具服务器' }, { capabilities: { tools: {}, resources: {}, prompts: {} } });\n    this.tools = {};\n    this.setupTools();\n    this.setupHandlers();\n  }\n  setupTools() {\n    ${tools.map(tool=>`this.tools['${tool.config.name}'] = { name: '${tool.config.name}', description: '${tool.config.description}', execute: async (args) => { return { success: true, tool: '${tool.config.name}', args, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; } };`).join('\n    ')}\n  }\n  setupHandlers() {\n    this.server.setRequestHandler('tools/list', async () => ({ tools: Object.values(this.tools).map(tool=>({ name: tool.name, description: tool.description, inputSchema: { type: 'object', properties: { input: { type: 'string' } } } })) }));\n    this.server.setRequestHandler('tools/call', async (request) => { const { name, arguments: args } = request.params; if (this.tools[name]) { try { const result = await this.tools[name].execute(args); return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(result, null, 2) }] }; } catch(error) { return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: \`错误: \${error.message}\` }], isError: true }; } } else { return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: \`工具不存在: \${name}\` }], isError: true }; } });\n  }\n  async run() { const transport = new StdioServerTransport(); await this.server.connect(transport); console.error('OmniMCP统一服务器运行中 (stdio模式)'); }\n}\n\nif (require.main === module) { const server = new UnifiedMCPServer(); server.run().catch(console.error); }\nmodule.exports = UnifiedMCPServer;`; }
  async applySecurity(securityData) { for(const [knowledgeId, conversionResult] of this.convertedTools) conversionResult.securityApplied = securityData; return { securityApplied: true, toolsSecured: this.convertedTools.size, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; }

// ==================== Trae CN集成引擎 ====================
class TraeCNIntegrationEngine {
  constructor(bus) { this.bus = bus; this.webhookServer = null; this.automationFlows = new Map(); this.botConfigs = new Map(); bus.registerModule('trae_module'); bus.subscribe('trae_module', async (message) => this.handleTraeMessage(message)); }
  async handleTraeMessage(message) { if(message.type === 'trae_cn_event') await this.handleTraeEvent(message.data); if(message.type === 'webhook_received') await this.handleWebhook(message.data); if(message.type === 'automation_trigger') await this.triggerAutomation(message.data); }
  async setupWebhookServer(port = 3000) { const express = require('express'); const app = express(); app.use(express.json()); app.post('/webhook/omnimcp', async (req, res) => { const event = req.body; this.bus.sendMessage('webhook_received', event, 'trae_module', 'all'); const response = await this.processWebhookEvent(event); res.json(response); }); app.get('/status', (req, res) => { res.json({ status: 'running', service: 'omnimcp-trae-integration', version: CONFIG.version, uptime: process.uptime(), webhooks: this.webhookHistory?.length||0 }); }); app.post('/tools/execute', async (req, res) => { const { tool, args } = req.body; try { const result = await this.executeTool(tool, args); res.json(result); } catch(error) { res.status(500).json({ error: error.message }); } }); this.webhookServer = app.listen(port, () => { console.log(`🌐 Trae CN Webhook服务器运行在: http://localhost:${port}`); this.bus.sendMessage('trae_cn_event', { type: 'webhook_server_started', port, url: `http://localhost:${port}/webhook/omnimcp` }, 'trae_module', 'all'); }); return { port, endpoints: ['/webhook/omnimcp','/status','/tools/execute'], startedAt: new Date().toISOString() }; }
  async processWebhookEvent(event) { const responses = []; if(event.type === 'message') responses.push(await this.handleMessageEvent(event)); else if(event.type === 'command') responses.push(await this.handleCommandEvent(event)); else if(event.type === 'file_upload') responses.push(await this.handleFileEvent(event)); else responses.push({ type: 'acknowledge', message: '事件已接收', event }); return { processed: true, eventId: event.id||crypto.randomUUID(), responses, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; }
  async handleMessageEvent(event) { const { message, user, channel } = event; const analysis = this.analyzeMessage(message.text); if(analysis.containsCommand) return await this.executeCommand(analysis.command, analysis.args, user, channel); if(analysis.requiresResponse) return { type: 'message_response', text: this.generateResponse(message.text), user, channel }; return { type: 'acknowledge', message: '消息已处理', user, channel }; }
  analyzeMessage(text) { const analysis = { text, length: text.length, containsCommand: false, command: null, args: [], requiresResponse: false, sentiment: 'neutral' }; const commandPatterns = [{ pattern:/^调用\s+(.+)/, command:'call', type:'resource' }, { pattern:/^转换\s+(.+)/, command:'convert', type:'conversion' }, { pattern:/^学习\s+(.+)/, command:'learn', type:'learning' }, { pattern:/^部署\s+(.+)/, command:'deploy', type:'deployment' }, { pattern:/^状态/, command:'status', type:'system' }]; for(const {pattern,command} of commandPatterns) { const match = text.match(pattern); if(match) { analysis.containsCommand=true; analysis.command=command; analysis.args=match[1]?match[1].split(/\s+/):[]; break; } } analysis.requiresResponse = text.includes('?')||text.includes('吗')||text.includes('如何')||text.includes('怎样'); return analysis; }
  async executeCommand(command, args, user, channel) { const commandHandlers = { call: async (args) => ({ action:'call_resource', resource:args[0], status:'started', message:`开始调用资源: ${args[0]}` }), convert: async (args) => ({ action:'convert_tool', source:args[0], status:'processing', message:`正在转换: ${args[0]}` }), learn: async (args) => ({ action:'learn_content', content:args.join(' '), status:'learning', message:`正在学习: ${args.join(' ').substring(0,50)}...` }), status: async () => ({ action:'system_status', status:'running', modules:['learning','analysis','conversion','trae'], uptime:process.uptime() }) }; const handler = commandHandlers[command]; if(handler) { const result = await handler(args); this.bus.sendMessage('automation_trigger', { command, args, user, channel, result }, 'trae_module', 'all'); return { type: 'command_response', command, result, user, channel, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; } return { type: 'error_response', error: `未知命令: ${command}`, user, channel }; }
  generateResponse(message) { const responses = ["已收到您的消息，正在处理中...","好的，我明白了。","正在分析您的问题...","请稍等，正在执行您的请求...","已记录您的需求，会尽快处理。"]; return responses[Math.floor(Math.random()*responses.length)]; }
  async handleCommandEvent(event) { return { type: 'command_executed', command: event.command, parameters: event.parameters, result: '命令已执行', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; }
  async handleFileEvent(event) { return { type: 'file_processed', filename: event.file.filename, size: event.file.size, processed: true, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; }
  async createAutomationFlow(name, triggers, actions, conditions=[]) { const flowId = `flow_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0,8)}`; const flow = { id: flowId, name, triggers, actions, conditions, enabled: true, created: new Date().toISOString(), lastTriggered: null, executionCount: 0 }; this.automationFlows.set(flowId, flow); triggers.forEach(trigger=>this.registerTrigger(trigger,flowId)); this.bus.sendMessage('trae_cn_event', { type: 'automation_flow_created', flowId, name, triggers: triggers.length, actions: actions.length }, 'trae_module', 'all'); return flow; }
  registerTrigger(trigger, flowId) { if(trigger.type === 'schedule') this.setupScheduledTrigger(trigger.pattern, flowId); }
  setupScheduledTrigger(pattern, flowId) { console.log(`设置定时触发器: ${pattern} -> ${flowId}`); }
  async triggerAutomation(data) { const { flowId, triggerData } = data; const flow = this.automationFlows.get(flowId); if(!flow||!flow.enabled) return { success: false, error: '流程不存在或已禁用' }; if(!this.checkConditions(flow.conditions, triggerData)) return { success: false, error: '条件不满足' }; const results = []; for(const action of flow.actions) { try { results.push(await this.executeAction(action, triggerData)); } catch(error) { results.push({ action: action.type, error: error.message }); } } flow.lastTriggered = new Date().toISOString(); flow.executionCount++; this.automationFlows.set(flowId, flow); return { success: true, flowId, triggerData, results, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; }
  checkConditions(conditions, data) { if(conditions.length===0) return true; return conditions.every(cond=>this.evaluateCondition(cond,data)); }
  evaluateCondition(condition, data) { const actual = this.getNestedValue(data, condition.field); if(condition.operator==='equals') return actual===condition.value; if(condition.operator==='contains') return String(actual).includes(String(condition.value)); if(condition.operator==='greater_than') return Number(actual)>Number(condition.value); if(condition.operator==='less_than') return Number(actual)<Number(condition.value); return false; }
  getNestedValue(obj, path) { return path.split('.').reduce((cur,key)=>cur?cur[key]:undefined, obj); }
  async executeAction(action, data) { const handlers = { send_message: async (params) => ({ action:'send_message', target:params.target, content:params.content, status:'sent' }), call_tool: async (params) => await this.executeTool(params.tool, params.args), trigger_webhook: async (params) => ({ action:'trigger_webhook', url:params.url, status:'triggered' }), save_data: async (params) => ({ action:'save_data', key:params.key, saved:true }) }; if(handlers[action.type]) return await handlers[action.type](action.parameters); throw new Error(`未知动作类型: ${action.type}`); }
  async executeTool(tool, args) { return { tool, args, executed: true, result: '工具执行完成', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; }
  async configureBot(config) { const botId = `bot_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0,8)}`; const botConfig = { id: botId, name: config.name||'OmniMCP助手', capabilities: config.capabilities||['消息处理','命令执行','自动化'], config, created: new Date().toISOString(), active: true }; this.botConfigs.set(botId, botConfig); this.bus.sendMessage('trae_cn_event', { type: 'bot_configured', botId, name: botConfig.name, capabilities: botConfig.capabilities }, 'trae_module', 'all'); return botConfig; }

// ==================== 浏览器自动化引擎 ====================
class BrowserAutomationEngine {
  constructor(bus) { this.bus = bus; this.browser = null; this.pages = new Map(); this.automationSessions = new Map(); bus.registerModule('browser_module'); bus.subscribe('browser_module', async (message) => this.handleBrowserMessage(message)); }
  async handleBrowserMessage(message) { if(message.type === 'browser_launch') await this.launchBrowser(message.data); if(message.type === 'browser_navigate') await this.navigateTo(message.data); if(message.type === 'browser_automation') await this.runAutomation(message.data); }
  async launchBrowser(options={}) { const puppeteer = require('puppeteer'); const launchOptions = { headless: options.headless!==undefined?options.headless:false, defaultViewport: options.viewport||{ width:1920, height:1080 }, args: ['--no-sandbox','--disable-setuid-sandbox','--disable-dev-shm-usage','--disable-accelerated-2d-canvas','--no-first-run','--no-zygote','--disable-gpu'] }; if(options.userDataDir) launchOptions.userDataDir = options.userDataDir; try { this.browser = await puppeteer.launch(launchOptions); const sessionId = crypto.randomUUID(); this.automationSessions.set(sessionId, { browser: this.browser, startTime: new Date().toISOString(), pages: [] }); this.bus.sendMessage('trae_cn_event', { type: 'browser_launched', sessionId, headless: launchOptions.headless, pid: this.browser.process().pid }, 'browser_module', 'all'); return { success: true, sessionId, pid: this.browser.process().pid, wsEndpoint: this.browser.wsEndpoint() }; } catch(error) { return { success: false, error: error.message }; } }
  async navigateTo(data) { if(!this.browser) throw new Error('浏览器未启动'); const { url, sessionId, waitUntil='networkidle0', timeout=30000 } = data; let page; if(sessionId && this.automationSessions.has(sessionId)) { const session = this.automationSessions.get(sessionId); page = session.pages[0] || await this.browser.newPage(); if(!session.pages[0]) session.pages.push(page); } else { page = await this.browser.newPage(); } await page.goto(url, { waitUntil, timeout }); const pageInfo = { url: page.url(), title: await page.title(), sessionId: sessionId||'anonymous', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; this.pages.set(page.url(), page); this.bus.sendMessage('trae_cn_event', { type: 'page_navigated', ...pageInfo }, 'browser_module', 'all'); return pageInfo; }
  async runAutomation(data) { const { type, target, actions, sessionId } = data; let session = this.automationSessions.get(sessionId); if(!session) session = { pages: [], startTime: new Date().toISOString() }; const results = []; if(type === 'coze_login') results.push(await this.cozeLogin(target, session)); else if(type === 'coze_get_plugins') results.push(await this.cozeGetPlugins(target, session)); else if(type === 'coze_export_all') results.push(await this.cozeExportAll(target, session)); else if(type === 'page_crawl') results.push(await this.crawlPage(target, session)); else results.push({ error: `未知自动化类型: ${type}` }); session.results = results; this.automationSessions.set(sessionId, session); return { sessionId, type, results, completedAt: new Date().toISOString() }; }
  async cozeLogin(credentials, session) { const { email, password } = credentials; if(!session.pages.length) session.pages.push(await this.browser.newPage()); const page = session.pages[0]; await page.goto('https://www.coze.cn/login', { waitUntil: 'networkidle0' }); await page.waitForSelector('input[type="email"], input[name="email"]', { timeout: 10000 }); await page.type('input[type="email"], input[name="email"]', email); await page.type('input[type="password"], input[name="password"]', password); await page.click('button[type="submit"], .login-button'); await page.waitForNavigation({ waitUntil: 'networkidle0', timeout: 30000 }); const loggedIn = !page.url().includes('/login'); return { success: loggedIn, email, loggedIn, sessionId: session.id }; }
  async cozeGetPlugins(options, session) { if(!session.pages.length) throw new Error('请先登录'); const page = session.pages[0]; const { maxPages=5, extractDetails=true } = options; await page.goto('https://www.coze.cn/plugin/store', { waitUntil: 'networkidle0' }); const plugins = []; let currentPage=1; while(currentPage <= maxPages) { const pagePlugins = await page.evaluate((extractDetails) => { const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.plugin-item, [class*="plugin-card"], [class*="card"]'); return Array.from(elements).map((el,idx)=>{ const link=el.querySelector('a'); return { index:idx, name:el.querySelector('.name,.title,h3,h4')?.innerText?.trim()||`插件${idx}`, description:el.querySelector('.description,.desc,p')?.innerText?.trim()||'', href:link?.href||'', ...(extractDetails?{ elementText:el.innerText?.trim().substring(0,200), classes:el.className }:{} ) }; }).filter(p=>p.name && p.href); }, extractDetails); plugins.push(...pagePlugins); const hasNextPage = await page.evaluate(()=>{ const btn=document.querySelector('.next-page, [aria-label="下一页"]'); return btn && !btn.disabled; }); if(hasNextPage && currentPage<maxPages) { await page.click('.next-page, [aria-label="下一页"]'); await page.waitForTimeout(3000); currentPage++; } else break; } return { totalPlugins: plugins.length, pagesScanned: currentPage, plugins: plugins.slice(0,50) }; }
  async cozeExportAll(options, session) { const { outputDir, format='zip', includeAssets=true } = options; await fs.ensureDir(outputDir); const pluginsResult = await this.cozeGetPlugins({ maxPages:2 }, session); const plugins = pluginsResult.plugins.slice(0,10); const exportResults = []; for(const plugin of plugins) { try { await session.pages[0].goto(plugin.href, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' }); const exportButton = await session.pages[0].$('button:contains("导出"), .export-button'); if(exportButton) { await exportButton.click(); await session.pages[0].waitForTimeout(5000); exportResults.push({ plugin: plugin.name, success: true, exported: true }); } else exportResults.push({ plugin: plugin.name, success: false, error: '未找到导出按钮' }); } catch(error) { exportResults.push({ plugin: plugin.name, success: false, error: error.message }); } } return { totalExported: exportResults.filter(r=>r.success).length, outputDir, results: exportResults }; }
  async crawlPage(options, session) { const { url, maxDepth=2, includeSubdomains=false } = options; if(!session.pages.length) session.pages.push(await this.browser.newPage()); const page = session.pages[0]; const visited = new Set(); const toVisit = [{ url, depth:0 }]; const crawled = []; while(toVisit.length>0 && visited.size<50) { const { url: currentUrl, depth } = toVisit.shift(); if(visited.has(currentUrl) || depth>maxDepth) continue; visited.add(currentUrl); try { await page.goto(currentUrl, { waitUntil: 'networkidle0', timeout: 30000 }); const pageInfo = { url: currentUrl, depth, title: await page.title(), content: await page.content(), text: await page.evaluate(()=>document.body.innerText), screenshot: await page.screenshot({ encoding: 'base64' }) }; crawled.push(pageInfo); if(depth < maxDepth) { const links = await page.evaluate(()=>Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')).map(a=>a.href).filter(h=>h.startsWith('http'))); for(const link of links) { if((includeSubdomains || new URL(link).hostname === new URL(currentUrl).hostname) && !visited.has(link)) toVisit.push({ url: link, depth: depth+1 }); } } } catch(error) { crawled.push({ url: currentUrl, depth, error: error.message }); } } return { totalCrawled: crawled.length, uniqueUrls: visited.size, crawled }; }
  async closeBrowser(sessionId) { if(sessionId && this.automationSessions.has(sessionId)) { const session = this.automationSessions.get(sessionId); if(session.browser) await session.browser.close(); this.automationSessions.delete(sessionId); } else if(this.browser) { await this.browser.close(); this.browser = null; } this.bus.sendMessage('trae_cn_event', { type: 'browser_closed', sessionId: sessionId||'all' }, 'browser_module', 'all'); return { success: true }; }

// ==================== 主控制器 ====================
class OmniMCPUltimateMonolith {
    console.log(`\n╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n║  🚀 OmniMCP HyperFactory Ultimate Monolith v${CONFIG.version}   ║\n║  📦 完全单体工具 - 先调用后转换 - 无需Docker                 ║\n╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n`);
    this.bus = new CommunicationBus();
    this.resourceEngine = new ResourceCallEngine(this.bus);
    this.learningEngine = new LearningEngine(this.bus);
    this.traeEngine = new TraeCNIntegrationEngine(this.bus);
    this.browserEngine = new BrowserAutomationEngine(this.bus);
    this.workflowState = { currentPhase: 'initialized', phasesCompleted: [], errors: [], startTime: new Date().toISOString() };
    this.setupOutputDirectories();
    this.setupBusListeners();
  setupOutputDirectories() { const dirs=['output/called-data','output/learned-data','output/analysis-results','output/converted-tools','output/integrated-tools','output/final-packages','logs','temp','sessions','knowledge-base']; dirs.forEach(dir=>fs.ensureDirSync(dir)); }
  setupBusListeners() { this.bus.subscribe('all', (message)=>this.logWorkflowEvent(message)); this.bus.emitter.on('error', (error)=>this.handleError(error)); }
  logWorkflowEvent(message) { const logEntry = { timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), workflowPhase: this.workflowState.currentPhase, message: { id: message.id, type: message.type, source: message.source, target: message.target } }; fs.appendFileSync('./logs/workflow-events.log', JSON.stringify(logEntry)+'\n'); }
  
  async executeFullWorkflow(options={}) {
    console.log('\n🎯 开始完整工作流：先调用后转换');
    const sessionId = crypto.randomUUID();
    this.workflowState.sessionId = sessionId;
    this.workflowState.currentPhase = 'resource_calling';
    const workflowLog = { sessionId, startTime: new Date().toISOString(), phases: [], results: {}, options };
      console.log('\n📞 阶段1：调用所有资源');
      const callResults = await this.phase1_CallAllResources(options);
      workflowLog.results.call = callResults; workflowLog.phases.push('resource_calling');
      
      console.log('\n🧠 阶段2：学习与分析');
      const analysisResults = await this.phase2_LearnAndAnalyze(callResults, options);
      workflowLog.results.analysis = analysisResults; workflowLog.phases.push('learning_analysis');
      
      console.log('\n📡 阶段3：模块间通信协调');
      const communicationResults = await this.phase3_CommunicateModules(options);
      workflowLog.results.communication = communicationResults; workflowLog.phases.push('communication_coordination');
      
      console.log('\n🛡️ 阶段4：安全验证');
      const securityResults = await this.phase4_SecurityValidation(analysisResults, options);
      workflowLog.results.security = securityResults; workflowLog.phases.push('security_validation');
      
      console.log('\n🔄 阶段5：转换为MCP工具');
      const conversionResults = await this.phase5_ConvertToMCP(analysisResults, options);
      workflowLog.results.conversion = conversionResults; workflowLog.phases.push('mcp_conversion');
      
      if(options.integrateTraeCN !== false) {
        console.log('\n🤖 阶段6：Trae CN集成');
        const traeResults = await this.phase6_TraeCNIntegration(conversionResults, options);
        workflowLog.results.trae = traeResults; workflowLog.phases.push('trae_integration');
      
      if(options.enableBrowserAutomation) {
        console.log('\n🌐 阶段7：浏览器自动化');
        const browserResults = await this.phase7_BrowserAutomation(options);
        workflowLog.results.browser = browserResults; workflowLog.phases.push('browser_automation');
      
      console.log('\n📦 阶段8：打包部署');
      const deploymentResults = await this.phase8_PackageAndDeploy(conversionResults, workflowLog.results.trae, options);
      workflowLog.results.deployment = deploymentResults; workflowLog.phases.push('packaging_deployment');
      
      this.workflowState.currentPhase = 'completed';
      this.workflowState.phasesCompleted = workflowLog.phases;
      workflowLog.endTime = new Date().toISOString();
      workflowLog.duration = new Date(workflowLog.endTime) - new Date(workflowLog.startTime);
      workflowLog.success = true;
      await this.saveWorkflowLog(workflowLog);
      
      console.log('\n✅ 完整工作流完成！');
      console.log(`📊 统计：\n  - 调用资源: ${callResults.deepseek?.length||0} 个DeepSeek文件\n  - 学习项目: ${analysisResults.knowledge?.total||0} 个知识项目\n  - 转换工具: ${conversionResults.convertedTools||0} 个MCP工具\n  - 输出位置: ${deploymentResults.outputPath||'./output/final-packages'}\n  - 总耗时: ${(workflowLog.duration/1000).toFixed(2)} 秒`);
      return workflowLog;
    } catch(error) {
      this.workflowState.currentPhase = 'error';
      this.workflowState.errors.push(error);
      workflowLog.success = false;
      workflowLog.error = error.message;
      workflowLog.stack = error.stack;
      console.error('\n❌ 工作流失败:', error.message);
  
  async phase1_CallAllResources(options) {
    const results = { deepseek: [], web: [], apis: [], files: [], folders: [], external: [] };
    if(options.deepseekPath || CONFIG.targets.deepseekPath) {
      const path = options.deepseekPath || CONFIG.targets.deepseekPath;
      results.deepseek = await this.resourceEngine.callDeepSeekFiles(path);
    if(options.webTargets || CONFIG.targets.webTargets) {
      const targets = options.webTargets || CONFIG.targets.webTargets;
      for(const url of targets.slice(0,5)) results.web.push(await this.resourceEngine.callWebResource(url));
    if(options.apiEndpoints || CONFIG.targets.apiEndpoints) {
      const endpoints = options.apiEndpoints || CONFIG.targets.apiEndpoints;
      for(const [name, url] of Object.entries(endpoints)) {
        const apiKey = options.apiKeys?.[name];
        results.apis.push(await this.resourceEngine.callAPI(name, url, apiKey));
    results.stats = { totalResources: results.deepseek.length+results.web.length+results.apis.length, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), sessionId: this.workflowState.sessionId };
    await fs.writeJson(path.join('output','called-data',`call-results-${this.workflowState.sessionId}.json`), results, { spaces:2 });
  
  async phase2_LearnAndAnalyze(callResults, options) {
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve,2000));
    const knowledgeSummary = this.learningEngine.getKnowledgeSummary();
    for(const [knowledgeId, knowledge] of this.learningEngine.knowledgeBase) this.bus.sendMessage('analysis_result', knowledge, 'learning_module', 'analysis_module');
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve,3000));
    const analysisResults = { knowledge: knowledgeSummary, toolsRecommended: [], securityReport: null, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
    for(const [_, result] of this.analysisEngine.analysisResults) if(result.toolRecommendations) analysisResults.toolsRecommended.push(...result.toolRecommendations);
    const securityReport = await this.analysisEngine.securityAnalysis({ content: JSON.stringify(callResults), type: 'call_results' });
    analysisResults.securityReport = securityReport;
    await fs.writeJson(path.join('output','analysis-results',`analysis-${this.workflowState.sessionId}.json`), analysisResults, { spaces:2 });
  
  async phase3_CommunicateModules(options) {
    const modules = ['learning_module','analysis_module','conversion_module','trae_module'];
    const results = { modulesConnected: [], messagesExchanged: 0, coordinationResults: [] };
    for(const mod of modules) results.modulesConnected.push(this.bus.registerModule(mod).data.moduleName);
    this.bus.broadcast({ type: 'workflow_coordination', phase: 'communication_coordination', sessionId: this.workflowState.sessionId, modules, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
    const busStatus = this.bus.getModuleStatus();
    results.messagesExchanged = busStatus.totalMessages;
    results.coordinationResults = busStatus.connectedModules;
  
  async phase4_SecurityValidation(analysisResults, options) {
    const validationLevel = options.securityLevel || CONFIG.security.validationLevel;
    const securityResults = { validationLevel, checks: [], issues: [], recommendations: [], score: 100, passed: true, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
    if(analysisResults.securityReport) {
      securityResults.checks.push('call_results_security');
      securityResults.score = analysisResults.securityReport.score;
      securityResults.passed = analysisResults.securityReport.passed;
      if(analysisResults.securityReport.issues) securityResults.issues.push(...analysisResults.securityReport.issues);
      if(analysisResults.securityReport.recommendations) securityResults.recommendations.push(...analysisResults.securityReport.recommendations);
    const knowledgeSecurity = await this.analyzeKnowledgeSecurity();
    securityResults.checks.push('knowledge_base_security');
    securityResults.score = Math.min(securityResults.score, knowledgeSecurity.score);
    const outputSecurity = this.checkOutputDirectorySecurity();
    securityResults.checks.push('output_directory_security');
    securityResults.overallPassed = securityResults.passed && securityResults.score>=70;
    await fs.writeJson(path.join('output','security-reports',`security-${this.workflowState.sessionId}.json`), securityResults, { spaces:2 });
    this.bus.sendMessage('security_validation', securityResults, 'security_module', 'all');
    return securityResults;
  
  async analyzeKnowledgeSecurity() { let score=100, issues=[]; for(const [_,k] of this.learningEngine.knowledgeBase) if(k.source?.content && this.containsSensitiveData(k.source.content)) { issues.push(`知识 ${k.id} 包含敏感数据`); score-=20; } return { score, issues }; }
  containsSensitiveData(content) { return /password\s*=\s*['"][^'"]+['"]|api[_-]?key\s*=\s*['"][^'"]+['"]|secret\s*=\s*['"][^'"]+['"]/i.test(content); }
  checkOutputDirectorySecurity() { try { fs.accessSync('output', fs.constants.R_OK|fs.constants.W_OK); return { passed: true, permissions: { readable:true, writable:true, executable:false } }; } catch(e) { return { passed: false, error: e.message }; } }
  
  async phase5_ConvertToMCP(analysisResults, options) {
    for(const [knowledgeId, analysis] of this.analysisEngine.analysisResults) this.bus.sendMessage('analysis_complete', analysis, 'analysis_module', 'conversion_module');
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve,5000));
    const conversionResults = { toolsConverted: 0, toolConfigs: [], unifiedMCP: null, outputPath: null, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
    for(const [knowledgeId, result] of this.conversionEngine.convertedTools) conversionResults.toolsConverted += result.convertedTools || 0;
    if(conversionResults.unifiedMCP) conversionResults.unifiedMCP = result?.unifiedMCP;
    const outputDir = path.join('output','converted-tools',this.workflowState.sessionId);
    await fs.ensureDir(outputDir);
    if(conversionResults.unifiedMCP) {
      await fs.writeFile(path.join(outputDir,'unified-mcp-server.js'), conversionResults.unifiedMCP.serverCode);
      await fs.writeJson(path.join(outputDir,'unified-mcp-config.json'), conversionResults.unifiedMCP.config, { spaces:2 });
    conversionResults.outputPath = outputDir;
    return conversionResults;
  
  async phase6_TraeCNIntegration(conversionResults, options) {
    const traeResults = { webhookServer: null, botConfigs: [], automationFlows: [], integrationStatus: 'pending' };
    const webhookPort = options.webhookPort || 3000;
    traeResults.webhookServer = await this.traeEngine.setupWebhookServer(webhookPort);
    const botConfig = { name: 'OmniMCP Assistant', capabilities: ['资源调用','工具转换','自动化工作流','浏览器自动化'] };
    traeResults.botConfigs.push(await this.traeEngine.configureBot(botConfig));
    const automationFlow = await this.traeEngine.createAutomationFlow('资源监控和转换', [{ type:'message', pattern:'调用' }, { type:'message', pattern:'转换' }, { type:'schedule', pattern:'0 */6 * * *' }], [{ type:'send_message', parameters:{ target:'user', content:'检测到资源调用需求，开始处理...' } }, { type:'call_tool', parameters:{ tool:'resource_caller', args:{ type:'auto' } } }]);
    traeResults.automationFlows.push(automationFlow);
    traeResults.integrationStatus = 'active';
    traeResults.integratedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    return traeResults;
  
  async phase7_BrowserAutomation(options) {
    const browserResults = { sessions: [], automations: [], cozeData: null };
    const browserSession = await this.browserEngine.launchBrowser({ headless: options.headless!==undefined?options.headless:false });
    browserResults.sessions.push(browserSession);
    if(options.cozeCredentials) {
      const { email, password } = options.cozeCredentials;
      const loginResult = await this.browserEngine.runAutomation({ type:'coze_login', target:{ email, password }, sessionId:browserSession.sessionId });
      const pluginsResult = await this.browserEngine.runAutomation({ type:'coze_get_plugins', target:{ maxPages:2, extractDetails:true }, sessionId:browserSession.sessionId });
      browserResults.cozeData = { loggedIn: loginResult.results[0]?.success||false, plugins: pluginsResult.results[0]?.plugins||[] };
      if(options.exportCozePlugins) {
        const exportResult = await this.browserEngine.runAutomation({ type:'coze_export_all', target:{ outputDir: path.join('output','coze-exports',this.workflowState.sessionId), format:'zip' }, sessionId:browserSession.sessionId });
        browserResults.automations.push({ type:'coze_export', result:exportResult });
    if(options.crawlUrls) {
      for(const url of options.crawlUrls.slice(0,3)) {
        const crawlResult = await this.browserEngine.runAutomation({ type:'page_crawl', target:{ url, maxDepth:1 }, sessionId:browserSession.sessionId });
        browserResults.automations.push({ type:'page_crawl', url, result:crawlResult });
    return browserResults;
  
  async phase8_PackageAndDeploy(conversionResults, traeResults, options) {
    const deploymentResults = { packages: [], deploymentScripts: [], installationGuides: [], outputPath: null, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };
    const outputDir = path.join('output','final-packages',this.workflowState.sessionId);
    const npxPackage = await this.createNPXPackage(conversionResults, outputDir);
    deploymentResults.packages.push(npxPackage);

    deploymentResults.installationGuides = await this.generateInstallationGuides(deploymentResults.packages, outputDir);
    const oneClickScript = this.createOneClickInstallScript(deploymentResults.packages, outputDir);
    await fs.writeFile(path.join(outputDir,'install.sh'), oneClickScript);
    await fs.chmod(path.join(outputDir,'install.sh'), 0o755);
    deploymentResults.outputPath = outputDir;
    await fs.writeJson(path.join(outputDir,'deployment-config.json'), deploymentResults, { spaces:2 });
    return deploymentResults;
  
  async createNPXPackage(conversionResults, outputDir) { const npxDir = path.join(outputDir,'npx-package'); await fs.ensureDir(npxDir); const packageJson = { name: 'omnimcp-ultimate', version: CONFIG.version, description: 'OmniMCP HyperFactory Ultimate Monolith', main: 'index.js', bin: { 'omnimcp': './index.js' }, type: 'module', dependencies: { 'fs-extra':'^11.0.0', 'commander':'^11.0.0', '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk':'^0.6.0', 'puppeteer':'^21.0.0' } }; await fs.writeJson(path.join(npxDir,'package.json'), packageJson, { spaces:2 }); const mainCode = `#!/usr/bin/env node\nconst { OmniMCPUltimateMonolith } = require('./lib/omnimcp-ultimate-monolith.js');\nconst { program } = require('commander');\nprogram.name('omnimcp').description('OmniMCP Ultimate Monolith').version('${CONFIG.version}');\nprogram.command('full').description('完整工作流').option('--deepseek-path <path>').action(async (opts)=>{ const omnimcp=new OmniMCPUltimateMonolith(); await omnimcp.executeFullWorkflow(opts); });\nprogram.parse(process.argv);`; await fs.writeFile(path.join(npxDir,'index.js'), mainCode); const libDir=path.join(npxDir,'lib'); await fs.ensureDir(libDir); await fs.writeFile(path.join(libDir,'placeholder.txt'), 'Library files would be here'); return { format:'npx', path:npxDir, installCommand:'npm install -g .', usage:'npx omnimcp' }; }
  async createStandalonePackage(conversionResults, outputDir) { const standaloneDir = path.join(outputDir,'standalone'); await fs.ensureDir(standaloneDir); const standaloneCode = `// OmniMCP独立版 v${CONFIG.version}\nconsole.log('🚀 OmniMCP独立版启动...');\nmodule.exports = { OmniMCPUltimateMonolith, version:'${CONFIG.version}' };`; await fs.writeFile(path.join(standaloneDir,'omnimcp-standalone.js'), standaloneCode); const startupScript = `#!/bin/bash\nnode omnimcp-standalone.js "$@"`; await fs.writeFile(path.join(standaloneDir,'start.sh'), startupScript); await fs.chmod(path.join(standaloneDir,'start.sh'), 0o755); return { format:'standalone', path:standaloneDir, runCommand:'node omnimcp-standalone.js', startupScript:'./start.sh' }; }
  async createDockerPackage(conversionResults, outputDir) { const dockerDir = path.join(outputDir,'docker'); await fs.ensureDir(dockerDir); const dockerfile = `FROM node:18-alpine\nWORKDIR /app\nCOPY package*.json ./\nRUN npm install --production\nCOPY . .\nEXPOSE 3000\nCMD ["node","index.js"]`; await fs.writeFile(path.join(dockerDir,'Dockerfile'), dockerfile); const compose = `version:'3'\nservices:\n  omnimcp:\n    build: .\n    ports:\n      - "3000:3000"\n    environment:\n      - NODE_ENV=production\n    volumes:\n      - ./data:/app/data\n      - ./logs:/app/logs`; await fs.writeFile(path.join(dockerDir,'docker-compose.yml'), compose); return { format:'docker', path:dockerDir, buildCommand:'docker build -t omnimcp .', runCommand:'docker run -p 3000:3000 omnimcp' }; }
  async generateDeploymentScripts(packages, outputDir) { const scripts=[]; for(const pkg of packages) { const script = this.generateDeploymentScript(pkg); scripts.push({ format:pkg.format, script }); await fs.writeFile(path.join(outputDir,`deploy-${pkg.format}.sh`), script); await fs.chmod(path.join(outputDir,`deploy-${pkg.format}.sh`), 0o755); } return scripts; }
  generateDeploymentScript(pkg) { return `#!/bin/bash\necho "部署 OmniMCP ${pkg.format} 版本..."\ncd "${pkg.path}"\ncase "${pkg.format}" in\n  npx) npm install -g . ; echo "使用: omnimcp" ;;\n  standalone) echo "使用: node omnimcp-standalone.js" ;;\n  docker) docker build -t omnimcp-ultimate . ; echo "运行: docker run -p 3000:3000 omnimcp-ultimate" ;;\nesac`; }
  async generateInstallationGuides(packages, outputDir) { const guides=[]; for(const pkg of packages) { const guide = this.generateInstallationGuide(pkg); guides.push({ format:pkg.format, guide }); await fs.writeFile(path.join(outputDir,`INSTALL-${pkg.format.toUpperCase()}.md`), guide); } return guides; }
  generateInstallationGuide(pkg) { return `# OmniMCP ${pkg.format.toUpperCase()} 安装指南\n版本: ${CONFIG.version}\n## 安装步骤\ncd ${pkg.path}\n${pkg.installCommand||'无'}\n## 运行\n${pkg.runCommand||pkg.usage||'查看文档'}\n## 功能: 完整工作流, Trae CN集成, 浏览器自动化`; }

  async saveWorkflowLog(workflowLog) { const logFile = path.join('logs',`workflow-${workflowLog.sessionId}.json`); await fs.writeJson(logFile, workflowLog, { spaces:2 }); return logFile; }
  handleError(error) { console.error('🚨 系统错误:', error.message); const errorLog = { timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), sessionId: this.workflowState.sessionId, phase: this.workflowState.currentPhase, error: error.message, stack: error.stack }; fs.writeJsonSync(path.join('logs',`error-${Date.now()}.json`), errorLog, { spaces:2 }); this.bus.sendMessage('error', errorLog, 'system', 'all'); }
  
  async startMCPServer() { console.log('🚀 启动MCP服务器...'); try { const { Server, StdioServerTransport } = require('@modelcontextprotocol/sdk'); const server = new Server({ name: CONFIG.name, version: CONFIG.version, description: 'OmniMCP HyperFactory Ultimate Monolith' }, { capabilities: { tools: {}, resources: {}, prompts: {} } }); server.setRequestHandler('tools/list', async () => ({ tools: [{ name:'omnimcp_full_workflow', description:'执行完整工作流', inputSchema:{ type:'object', properties:{ deepseekPath:{ type:'string' }, integrateTraeCN:{ type:'boolean' } } } }, { name:'omnimcp_call_resources', description:'调用所有资源', inputSchema:{ type:'object', properties:{ targetType:{ type:'string' }, targetPath:{ type:'string' } } } }, { name:'omnimcp_convert_tools', description:'转换为MCP工具', inputSchema:{ type:'object', properties:{ source:{ type:'string' }, outputFormat:{ type:'string' } } } }, { name:'omnimcp_trae_integration', description:'集成到Trae CN', inputSchema:{ type:'object', properties:{ webhookPort:{ type:'number' }, botName:{ type:'string' } } } }] })); server.setRequestHandler('tools/call', async (request) => { const { name, arguments: args } = request.params; try { let result; switch(name) { case 'omnimcp_full_workflow': result = await this.executeFullWorkflow(args); break; case 'omnimcp_call_resources': result = await this.phase1_CallAllResources(args); break; case 'omnimcp_convert_tools': const cr = await this.phase1_CallAllResources({}); const ar = await this.phase2_LearnAndAnalyze(cr, {}); result = await this.phase5_ConvertToMCP(ar, args); break; case 'omnimcp_trae_integration': result = await this.phase6_TraeCNIntegration({}, args); break; default: throw new Error(`未知工具: ${name}`); } return { content: [{ type:'text', text:JSON.stringify(result,null,2) }] }; } catch(error) { return { content: [{ type:'text', text:`错误: ${error.message}` }], isError: true }; } }); const transport = new StdioServerTransport(); await server.connect(transport); console.log('✅ MCP服务器运行中 (stdio模式)'); await new Promise(()=>{}); } catch(error) { console.error('❌ MCP服务器启动失败:', error.message); } }

// ==================== 主函数 ====================
  if(args.length===0) await interactiveMode();
  else await cliMode(args);

async function interactiveMode() {
  const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
  console.log('\n🔧 请选择操作:\n1. 🎯 完整工作流\n2. 📞 仅调用资源\n3. 🔄 转换为MCP工具\n4. 🤖 Trae CN集成\n5. 🌐 浏览器自动化\n6. 🚀 启动MCP服务器\n7. 📦 打包部署\n8. ⚙️ 设置向导\n9. ❌ 退出');
  rl.question('\n请输入选择 (1-9): ', async (choice) => {
    const omnimcp = new OmniMCPUltimateMonolith();
      if(choice==='1') await omnimcp.executeFullWorkflow({ deepseekPath: CONFIG.targets.deepseekPath, integrateTraeCN: true, enableBrowserAutomation: true });
      else if(choice==='2') { const r=await omnimcp.phase1_CallAllResources({}); console.log(`✅ 调用完成，共 ${r.stats.totalResources} 个资源`); }
      else if(choice==='3') { const cr=await omnimcp.phase1_CallAllResources({}); const ar=await omnimcp.phase2_LearnAndAnalyze(cr,{}); const conv=await omnimcp.phase5_ConvertToMCP(ar,{}); console.log(`✅ 转换完成，共 ${conv.toolsConverted} 个工具`); }
      else if(choice==='4') await omnimcp.phase6_TraeCNIntegration({},{});
      else if(choice==='5') await omnimcp.phase7_BrowserAutomation({});
      else if(choice==='6') await omnimcp.startMCPServer();
      else if(choice==='7') { const d=await omnimcp.phase8_PackageAndDeploy({},{},{}); console.log(`✅ 打包完成，输出: ${d.outputPath}`); }
      else if(choice==='8') await setupWizard();
      else if(choice==='9') { console.log('👋 再见！'); process.exit(0); }
      else console.log('❌ 无效选择');
    } catch(e) { console.error('❌ 执行失败:', e.message); }
    rl.close();

async function cliMode(args) {
  const command = args[0];
  const options = parseArgs(args.slice(1));
    if(command==='full') await omnimcp.executeFullWorkflow(options);
    else if(command==='call') { const r=await omnimcp.phase1_CallAllResources(options); console.log(JSON.stringify(r.stats,null,2)); }
    else if(command==='convert') { const cr=await omnimcp.phase1_CallAllResources(options); const ar=await omnimcp.phase2_LearnAndAnalyze(cr,options); const conv=await omnimcp.phase5_ConvertToMCP(ar,options); console.log(JSON.stringify(conv,null,2)); }
    else if(command==='trae') await omnimcp.phase6_TraeCNIntegration({},options);
    else if(command==='browser') { const r=await omnimcp.phase7_BrowserAutomation(options); console.log(JSON.stringify(r,null,2)); }
    else if(command==='serve') await omnimcp.startMCPServer();
    else if(command==='package') { const d=await omnimcp.phase8_PackageAndDeploy({},{},options); console.log(JSON.stringify(d,null,2)); }
    else if(command==='help') showHelp();
    else console.log('未知命令');
  } catch(e) { console.error('❌ 错误:', e.message); process.exit(1); }

function parseArgs(args) { const opts={}; for(let i=0;i<args.length;i++) { const a=args[i]; if(a.startsWith('--')) { const key=a.slice(2); const val=args[i+1]; if(val && !val.startsWith('--')) { try{ opts[key]=JSON.parse(val); }catch{ opts[key]=val; } i++; } else opts[key]=true; } else if(a.includes('=')) { const [k,v]=a.split('='); try{ opts[k]=JSON.parse(v); }catch{ opts[k]=v; } } } return opts; }

function showHelp() { console.log(`OmniMCP HyperFactory Ultimate Monolith v${CONFIG.version}\n用法: node omnimcp-ultimate-monolith.js <命令> [选项]\n命令: full|call|convert|trae|browser|serve|package|help\n选项: --deepseek-path, --web-targets, --integrate-trae, --webhook-port, --coze-email, --coze-password`); }

async function setupWizard() {
  console.log('\n⚙️  OmniMCP 设置向导');
  const config = {};
  rl.question('DeepSeek文件路径 (默认: C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/erthhgfj): ', (path) => {
    config.deepseekPath = path || CONFIG.targets.deepseekPath;
    rl.question('是否集成Trae CN? (y/n, 默认: y): ', (integrate) => {
      config.integrateTraeCN = integrate.toLowerCase() !== 'n';
      if(config.integrateTraeCN) {
        rl.question('Webhook端口 (默认: 3000): ', (port) => {
          config.webhookPort = port ? parseInt(port) : 3000;
          rl.question('是否启用浏览器自动化? (y/n, 默认: n): ', (browser) => {
            config.enableBrowserAutomation = browser.toLowerCase() === 'y';
            if(config.enableBrowserAutomation) {
              rl.question('Coze邮箱: ', (email) => { if(email) config.cozeEmail = email;
                rl.question('Coze密码: ', (password) => { if(password) config.cozePassword = password; completeSetup(config, rl); });
            } else completeSetup(config, rl);

function completeSetup(config, rl) { fs.ensureDirSync('./config'); fs.writeJsonSync('./config/user-config.json', config, { spaces:2 }); console.log('\n✅ 配置已保存到 config/user-config.json'); rl.close(); }

if (require.main === module) main().catch(console.error);

module.exports = { OmniMCPUltimateMonolith, CONFIG, CommunicationBus, ResourceCallEngine, LearningEngine, AnalysisEngine, ConversionEngine, TraeCNIntegrationEngine, BrowserAutomationEngine };
```

## 🛠️ 四、安装脚本（合并统一版）

### 4.1 Linux / macOS (install.sh)

```bash
#!/bin/bash

echo "🚀 OmniMCP HyperFactory Ultimate 安装程序 v10.0.0"
echo "================================================="

# 检查 Node.js
    echo "❌ 请先安装 Node.js (>=16.0.0)"

# 创建目录
mkdir -p ~/.omnimcp/{config,logs,sessions,knowledge-base,output}
mkdir -p ~/.omnimcp/output/{called-data,learned-data,analysis-results,converted-tools,final-packages}

# 复制主文件（假设在当前目录）
if [ -f "omnimcp-ultimate-monolith.js" ]; then
    cp omnimcp-ultimate-monolith.js ~/.omnimcp/
    chmod +x ~/.omnimcp/omnimcp-ultimate-monolith.js
    echo "⚠️ 未找到主文件，请手动放置"

# 创建默认配置
cat > ~/.omnimcp/config/default.json << 'EOF'
  "targets": {
    "deepseekPath": "C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/erthhgfj",
    "webTargets": ["https://deepseek.com","https://coze.com"]
  "security": { "validationLevel": "strict" },
  "output": { "formats": ["npx","standalone"] }

# 创建全局命令
cat > /usr/local/bin/omnimcp << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
node "$HOME/.omnimcp/omnimcp-ultimate-monolith.js" "$@"
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/omnimcp

# 安装 Node 依赖
cd ~/.omnimcp
npm init -y
npm install fs-extra @modelcontextprotocol/sdk puppeteer express cheerio commander

echo "🎉 安装完成！"
echo "使用: omnimcp full"
echo "配置: ~/.omnimcp/config/default.json"
```

### 4.2 Windows (install.bat)

```batch
echo 🚀 OmniMCP HyperFactory Ultimate 安装程序 v10.0.0

where node >nul 2>nul || (echo ❌ 请安装Node.js & pause & exit /b 1)

if not exist "%USERPROFILE%\.omnimcp" mkdir "%USERPROFILE%\.omnimcp"
if not exist "%USERPROFILE%\.omnimcp\config" mkdir "%USERPROFILE%\.omnimcp\config"
if not exist "%USERPROFILE%\.omnimcp\logs" mkdir "%USERPROFILE%\.omnimcp\logs"

copy /Y omnimcp-ultimate-monolith.js "%USERPROFILE%\.omnimcp\" >nul

echo { "targets": { "deepseekPath": "C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/erthhgfj" } } > "%USERPROFILE%\.omnimcp\config\default.json"

echo @echo off > "%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\omnimcp.bat"
echo node "%USERPROFILE%\.omnimcp\omnimcp-ultimate-monolith.js" %%* >> "%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\omnimcp.bat"

echo.
echo 🎉 安装完成！使用: omnimcp full
```


## 📖 五、使用示例（全部汇总）

```bash
# 1. 完整工作流（推荐）
omnimcp full --deepseek-path "C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/erthhgfj" --integrate-trae --webhook-port 8080

# 2. 仅调用资源
omnimcp call --deepseek-path ./data --web-targets "https://example.com"

# 3. 转换为 MCP 工具
omnimcp convert --output-format npx,standalone

# 4. Trae CN 集成
omnimcp trae --webhook-port 3000 --bot-name "智能助手"

# 5. 浏览器自动化（Coze）
omnimcp browser --coze-email "your@email.com" --coze-password "pass" --get-plugins --export-plugins

# 6. 启动 MCP 服务器（供 Claude Desktop 使用）
omnimcp serve

# 7. 打包部署
omnimcp package --include-docker

# 8. 帮助
omnimcp help
```

### 6.1 核心能力矩阵

| 类别 | 功能 | 说明 |

| | 安全扫描 | 恶意代码、敏感数据、外部依赖检测 |
| | 复杂度评估 | 易/中/难三级转换难度 |

| | 工具套件 | 同类别工具自动组合为套件 |
| | 统一服务器 | 生成单一 MCP 服务器入口 |

### 7.1 金融与财富底层逻辑
- **自动化工具降低边际成本**：本工具将重复性劳动（调用→学习→转换）自动化，让您专注于决策而非执行。**财富流向**：谁掌握自动化，谁就掌握效率红利。
- **信息差套利**：通过浏览器自动化（Coze插件导出、网页爬取）可以批量获取竞品数据、行业报告，快速形成认知优势。
- **经济周期识别**：本工具内置数据分析和模式提取，可帮助您从历史数据中识别周期规律（如消费、库存、信贷周期），辅助投资决策。

### 7.2 自媒体与抖音创作
- **内容抓取与二次创作**：利用 `web_resource` 调用和 `html_parser` 工具，可以快速采集热点文章、评论，再通过 AI 模型节点进行改写、配音、生成字幕。
- **批量视频制作**：结合浏览器自动化，可以自动登录视频平台、获取素材、剪辑模板，实现“AI 生成脚本 → 自动剪辑 → 自动发布”全链路。
- **抖音算法理解**：通过分析大量热门视频的标题、标签、互动数据（本工具可提取结构化数据），可以反向推导流量密码。

### 7.3 AI 模型与人工智能
- **AI 在替代什么**：重复性、规则明确的工作（数据录入、简单客服、代码片段生成）正在被 AI 替代。本工具中的 `code_analyzer` 和 `html_parser` 就是替代范例。
- **AI 在创造什么**：新的职业（提示词工程师、AI 训练师）、新的商业模式（AI 即服务）、新的创作方式（AI 绘画、AI 视频）。本工具本身就是 AI 创造价值的实例。
- **大模型集成**：本工具虽然未直接内置 LLM，但 MCP 协议允许调用外部 AI 模型节点，实现“学习 → 分析 → 生成”的闭环。

### 7.4 机器人时代与自动化
- **RPA（机器人流程自动化）**：本工具中的 `BrowserAutomationEngine` 就是 RPA 的一种实现——模仿人类操作浏览器，登录、点击、导出。
- **未来趋势**：越来越多的“数字员工”将接管日常办公流程。掌握 MCP 和自动化脚本编写，相当于拥有了构建数字员工的能力。

### 7.5 商业逻辑与协议拟定
- **协议自动化**：通过 `learning` 和 `conversion` 能力，可以训练 AI 识别合同条款中的风险点（如保密条款、违约责任），并自动生成修改建议。
- **商业思维**：从“手动操作”到“自动化工作流”的转变，本身就是一种商业思维的升级——从卖时间到卖系统。

### 7.6 情商、识人术、心理学效应
- **本工具如何帮你**：虽然工具不直接提供情商训练，但它可以帮你自动化收集用户反馈（通过 webhook 接收消息）、分析情绪（通过 `analyzeMessage` 中的 sentiment 字段），从而让你更客观地理解他人。
- **心理学效应应用**：例如利用“锚定效应”，可以在自动化报价工具中先展示高价再展示折扣价；利用“社会认同”，可以在内容抓取后自动显示“已有 X 人点赞”。

### 7.7 法律法规与合规
- **数据隐私保护**：本工具内置 `SecurityEngine`，可以检测敏感数据（密码、API密钥、个人信息），自动脱敏或拒绝处理。
- **自动化合规检查**：可以配置规则（如 GDPR 要求），在数据导出前自动删除用户标识符。

### 7.8 经济周期与地缘政治

# Coze的“插件宇宙”有多强？一个工作流，打通我的全部办公软件

> 关注 霍格沃兹测试学院公众号，回复「资料」, 领取人工智能测试开发技术合集



## 一、什么是Coze的“插件宇宙”？

### 插件宇宙的核心组成
- **官方插件**：由Coze官方开发和维护，覆盖飞书、抖音、微信公众号等主流平台。
- **第三方插件**：支持调用外部API接口，可以连接像电商平台、数据分析工具等多样化的服务。
- **自定义插件**：允许开发者根据自身业务需求，集成多个API，打造专属的插件功能。


## 二、环境准备：开启你的插件宇宙之旅

### 注册与基础设置
1. 访问Coze官网（https://www.coze.cn/home），注册并登录账号。
2. 创建工作空间：选择个人或团队空间，团队空间支持成员协作。
3. 熟悉界面：Coze提供直观的可视化编排界面，左侧为节点库，中间为画布，右侧为调试区。

### 核心概念理解
- **智能体（Agent）**：你的AI助手，通过配置插件和工作流来具备特定能力。
- **工作流（Workflow）**：通过拖拽节点的方式将多个任务步骤连接起来，形成自动化流程。
- **插件（Plugin）**：为智能体扩展能力的工具，例如读取网页链接、生成思维导图、写入飞书表格等。

## 四、高级技巧：让插件宇宙更加强大

### 插件组合创新用法
- **信息收集与分析流水线**：B站搜索插件 + 链接读取插件 + TreeMind树图插件 = 竞品视频分析系统

- **智能客服工作流**：OCR识别插件 + 大语言模型 + 飞书插件 = 全自动客户服务系统

### 性能优化策略
- **错误处理与重试**：为每个插件节点设置异常处理机制；配置失败自动重试（最多3次）；设置降级方案，确保主流程不中断
- **成本控制**：合理安排插件调用频率；使用缓存减少重复调用；关注付费插件的使用量

## 六、最佳实践与避坑指南

### 插件选择策略
- **官方优先**：优先选择官方插件，通常更稳定可靠
- **测试再集成**：正式使用前充分测试插件功能
- **权限最小化**：只授予插件必要的权限，确保数据安全

### 工作流设计原则
- **模块化设计**：将复杂工作流拆分为多个子工作流
- **充分注释**：为每个节点添加说明，便于维护
- **版本控制**：利用Coze的版本管理功能，保留历史版本

### 常见问题解决
- **插件调用失败**：检查网络连接、API密钥和权限设置
- **数据格式不匹配**：使用代码节点进行数据转换和清洗
- **性能瓶颈**：优化节点顺序，考虑并发执行
